tei:div.tei:p: (hūm̐)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i bka' khrid kyi zin bris khyab bdag bla ma'i zhal lung snying gi mun sel gsang chen grub pa'i mchog sbyin bzhugs so// ༈ /gsung gi rdo rje'i gsang ba yongs rdzogs ngag la dbang bsgyur yan lag drug cu'i rgyud rer yang*// kun dga'i dpal ster grangs med chos kyi phung po mtha' dag ma tshang med pa'i dbyangs bdun pas// sras bcas rgyal rnams legs par gshegs pa'i lam du srid pa'i kha lo bder 'dren mkhas// dngos grub 'byung gnas rtsa ba'i bla mar gus pas 'dud do byang chub bar du brtse bas skyongs// rang bzhin 'od gsal stong pa mchog gi dwangs shel chags pa chen po'i dmar 'od kyis// gzi brjid stong 'bar zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku yi sgyu 'phrul 'jig rten snang ba'i mig /mngon sum 'char ba'i dga' ston gsar pas mkha' spyod grub pa padma dkar po'i tshal// bde blags rgyas pa'i mchog sbyin mdzod cig rgyal ba'i yum gyur rdo rje btsun mo kye// rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud don nā ro pa'i// thugs mtshor 'babs pa rnam dpyod hub gcig gis// 'dren mkhas bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa'i// grags dkar 'chi ba med pa'i bcud du mngar// gang de'i ring lugs nam mkha'i mdzod kyi sgor// zhugs min gangs can mkhas grub de su zhig /'on kyang snyan brgyud nor bu tshar pa rje// ma dros bdag po'i gdengs ka kho nas bzung*// de las 'ongs pa'i gsang chen slob bshad bstan// 'jigs med gdong lnga'i sgra yis srid pa gsum// zil gyis gnon nus khyab bdag gnas gsar ba// kho bo'i bla ma'i bka' brgyud las gzhan min// de phyir snyigs ma'i tshe thung them skas las// mkha' spyod gsang ba'i nye lam la brgyud de// kun mkhyen gzhal med khang par 'jug pa'i tshul// gsang chen rgyud sde'i nying khu 'di na spel// de la 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gser chos snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i nye lam gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa ji ltar nyams su len tshul rnams/

gsang chen bstan pa'i 'byung khungs yar klung bkra shis chos sde'i gzim khang chen mor khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang zhal mi gnyis pa gnas gsar ba chen po ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs 'du'i sde'am mtshan gzhan lha rig 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan zhes bka' drin mtshungs pa ma mchis pa yongs 'dzin bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad yun ring du bsten par dgyes pa chen pos gsang chen slob bshad 'dzin pa'i phyag bzhes chen mo 'khrul pa med pa'i rgyun ltar bka' khrid kyi zab bshad zla ba gcig gi bar stsal zhing*/ rang ngos nas kyang thun bzhi'i nyams len chag med du bskyangs skabs bla ma dam pa'i gsung bshad rgya che ba rnams blos ji bzhin 'dzin par ga la nus kyang*/ dmigs rim gyi khrid rkang rnams 'ol tshod dpe 'thor bsdus pa'i bsgrig chag ma yin par bla ma'i gsung byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams pa rnams brjed par 'phang ste nyin re zin bris su bkod pa la/ nyin bzhin chos thun gyi thog mar rdor sems bsgom bzlas kyi he ru ka'i yig brgya nyer gcig re'i mthar rdor sems rang la bstim/ rang lugs kyi gsung gdangs dang bcas brgyud 'debs pad dkar bzhad pa'i dga' ston lam rim smon lam dang mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam rnams dpon slob lhan cig tu mdzad/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇḍal 'bul mchod bstod re gnang*/ de nas gsung bshad kyi thog ma'i mtshams sbyor 'di ltar gsung*/ 'o/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du ston pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zung 'jug sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang sku tshe 'di nyid la ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab pa las ches zab pa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi khrid kyi rim pa zab mo gsan la don thugs nyams su bzhes dgongs pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab pa dang*/

chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa yang*/ skyes rabs las/ rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal ni nye bar bzhag /dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis lta// tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin// gus pa bskyed de rtse gcig tu// rab tu dwangs la dri med yid// nad pas sman pa'i tshig nyan bzhin// rim gro bskyed de chos nyon cig /ces gsungs pa ltar snod kyi skyon gsum spangs shing 'du shes drug bsten pa dang*/ khyad par du tha mal gyi snang zhen dang bcas pas gsang sngags zab mo'i chos gsan pa'i snod du mi rung bas gnas khang 'di yang dag pa'i gzhal yas khang du gsal ba'i phyi rol du dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa/ de'i dbus su chos 'chad pa po'i bla ma yang seṅge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du rje btsun mkha' spyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur mngon sum lta bur gsal ba'i zhal nas chos kyi sgra dbyangs grags stong skye ba med pa'i ngang du lhang lhang sgrog pas srid zhi'i rgud pa thams cad gzhom par byed pa dngos yin snyam pa dang*/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyang thun mtshams kyi lha'i sku gsal stong 'dzin pa med pa'i ngang nas yengs pa med pa'i tshul gyis gsan pa bka' drin bskyangs par zhu/ zhes brda sprod par mdzad pa'i rjes su chos 'di'i brgyud tshul bka' babs kyi che ba sogs rgyas par gsungs nas/ nyin dang po khrid gzhung dngos la/ de la 'dir gangs can bstan pa'i bdag po rje btsun sa skya pa chen po yab sras rnams la gsang sngags bla med dang 'brel ba'i gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu phyag tu bab pa las mchog tu gyur pa sa skya'i lcags ri las mi 'da' ba'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi nang tshan mchog sgrub pas thun mong gi dngos grub zhar la 'byung ba mkha' spyod skor gsum la thugs dam chag med rnam bzhi'i ya gyal rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i khrid kyi rim pa nyams su len pa la/

gang gis nyams su len pa'i rten/ des nyams su blang bya'i lam dngos/ lam de mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu dang gsum/ dang po la smin lam 'jug rung gi gang zag dang*/ grol lam bsgom rung gi gang zag gnyis/ dang po ni/ rab 'khor lo sdom pa lū nag dril gsum gang rung ngam/ tha ma kyai rdo rje lta bu ma rgyud gang yang rung ba'i rdul tshon nam ras dris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang gis rgyud smin par byas pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ lte ba'i tsaṇḍa lī nang gi rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bor gdod ma nas lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pa mngon sum rang ngo 'phrod pa'i thabs zab mo 'di'i sgos kyi sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin gyis rlabs pa legs par thob nas dam tshig dang sdom par gnas shing chag med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i skal ba can no// gnyis pa nyams su blang bya'i lam dngos ni/ gang zag dbang po rab byin rlabs thob nas chag med kyi nyams len dang tshes bcu gnyis kyi mchod pa la brtson cing*/ gzhi'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin par byas pas tshe 'di nyid la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal bud med kyi rnam pas zhal bstan cing rnal 'byor pa'i lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod kyi gnas su khrid pa dang*/ dbang po 'bring gis gzhi bsnyen yi ge'i grangs kyi 'bum phrag tsam btang ste laṅka li ya'i sgrub pa la brten nas phyogs kun tu btsal bas/ rnal 'byor ma mi mo'i rnam pa can gang yin pa de'i dpral bar sindhu ra'i dga' 'khyil gyi ri mo 'phos pas ngo shes te gsol ba btab pa la brten nas sngar bzhin tshe der rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ dbang po tha ma 'da' ka ma'i 'pho ba'am bar do'i nyams len la brten nas dus der rnal 'byor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'ja' yi gur khang*/ me tog gi char/ rol mo sogs kyis mchod rdzas dang bcas rnal 'byor pa seṅge'i khrir bkod nas mkha' spyod du khrid pa dang*/

dbang po shin tu rtul ba skye ba phyi mar lam gyi 'phro 'thud de mkha' spyod du khrid pa dang bzhi las/ de dag thams cad kyi thun mong du nyams su blang bya'i lam ni/ rje sa chen gyis/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myong*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis rlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes rnal 'byor bcu gcig tu bsdu bar mdzad pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi lam gyi rim pa gnyis las/ dang po la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum las/ dang po la thun mong ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ dang po la dal 'byor ngos bzung ba/ dpe/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ grangs sogs kyi sgo nas rnyed par dka' tshul gyi gsung bshad rgyas par mdzad/ gnyis pa la bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad pa bskyed rim gyi bya ba dang*/ bcad don nyams su len pa sems 'dzin gyi bya ba gnyis kyi sgo nas skabs su gang babs kyis thad kar rim pas 'chad pa la tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor gyi khongs su gtogs pa lam log pa phyi rol mu stegs byed las khyad par du bya ba skyabs 'gro'i khrid dang*/ lam dman pa nyan rang las khyad par du bya ba sems bskyed kyi khrid/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba yi ge brgya pa'i khrid/ mthun rkyen tshogs gsog pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang bzhi/ dang po la/ gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba'i rten/ tshul ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang nyid bde ba'i stan la lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun gyis 'khod/ dbugs rlung rngam pa rang babs su ma zhi'i bar chad pa ngal bso ba'i tshul gyis bzhag de nas rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs gnas khang sogs la dmigs pa ched du gtad pas de dag nam mkha' la na bun dengs pa bzhin bun long gis yal/

sa phyogs thams cad baiḍūrya'i sa gzhi la gser gyi mig mang ris su bres pa/ mnan na nam byed cing btegs na spar byed pa/ reg na bde ba phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su thar pa chen po'i ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ gser gyi rgya phibs kyi rtse mor nor bu'i tog gis brgyan pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba/ mtho khyad tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du sleb pa/ de'i nang*/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i brdar gser dngul margad sogs rang rang gi kha dog dang 'od zer so sor gsal ba'i rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba gang la yang 'jigs pa med pa'i brdar phyogs re nas seṅge gnyis gnyis te seṅge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa/ de'i steng du chags sogs nyes pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar padma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa/ da lta kha bye ma thag pa lta bu/ dri bsung phun sum tshogs pa 'phro ba/ de'i steng du ma rig mun pa 'joms pa'i brdar zla ba dang nyi ma brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ ngo bo rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la rnam pa sangs rgyas rdo rje chos/ gdul bya rnams la snying rje chen pos rjes su chags pa'i rang mdangs sku mdog dmar zhing gsal ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol te 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa de nyid brgyud pa'i bla ma gong ma gong mas 'og ma 'og mar byin gyis rlabs pa'i byin rlabs thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor yin pas bla ma kun 'dus/ phung po lnga de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i ngo bor bzhugs pas sangs rgyas kun 'dus/ thugs rgyud la mnga' ba'i 'gog lam gyi bden pa gnyis dang gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cus legs par 'doms pa'i chos kyi phung po brgyad khri zhi stong sogs dam chos kun 'dus/

skye mched rnams sems dpa' sems ma/ yan lag rnams khro bo khro mo/ yon tan nor lha/ phrin las chos srung gi ngo bor bzhugs pas dge 'dun kun 'dus/ mdor na skyabs gnas yod do cog thams cad ma tshang ba med pa'i ngo bo kun 'dus nor bu lugs su bskyed/ de'i mtha' skor du grangs med kyi skyabs gnas gzhan bsgom kyang rung la ma bsgoms kyang chad pa'i nyes pa med/ gnyis pa gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba'i rten ni rang gi g.yas su pha/ g.yon du ma/ mdun du dgra/ mtha' skor du rigs drug gi sems can thams cad rang rang gi byad dbyibs kyi rnam pa can du smug shig ge 'khod pa/ de thams cad kyis lus gus shing 'dud pa/ ngag snyan par skyabs 'gro/ yid dad pas khyed shes khyed mkhyen gyis mos gus rtse gcig tu yod par bsam/ gsum pa tshul ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ skyabs 'gro'i rgyu rang dang sems can thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal la 'jigs nas/ 'jigs pa de las skyabs pa'i nus pa su la yod na mdun na bzhugs pa'i ngo bo dkon mchog gsum la yod nges te/ chos thams cad lag mthil du skyu ru ra bzhag pa ltar mngon sum du gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ sems can thams cad la mas bu gcig par brtse ba lta bu'i brtse ba'i thugs rje/ sku las sprul pa'i 'od zer re res kyang sems can grangs med pa smin grol du 'god par mdzad pa'i skyob pa'i nus mthu tshad med pa yod nges snyam pa dang*/ yon tan de lta bu thob 'dod shugs drag po dang bcas 'jigs pa dad pa yid ches 'dod pa'i 'dun pa rnams kyi sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsam pa dang*/ dus kyang ji srid 'tsho'i bar lta bu yun thung ngu ma yin par byang chub ma thob kyi bar dang*/ don du gnyer bya yang rang gcig pu tsam ma yin par sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob 'dod kyi bsam pa dang bcas rang gis byang drongs te bdag gzhan thams cad kyis skyabs 'gro'i tshig 'ur ding gis brjod par bsam la/

bdag dang zhes pa'i skabs su rang*/ 'gro ba zhes sogs kyi skabs mtha' skor gyi sems can/ dus 'di nas sogs kyi dus kyi khyad par rnams yid la dran par byed/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhes pa'i skabs bla ma'i thugs ka'i thad du dmigs pa ched du gtad nas bdag gi rnam 'dren mdzad du gsol snyam la skyabs 'gro'i 'dun pa shugs drag tu bskyed pas rang nyid bla ma'i thugs kar mos gus kyi stobs drag pos thim la khad pa lta bur song ba'i mos pa byed/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas la zhes pa'i skabs su bla ma'i phung po lnga la dmigs te bdag gi skyabs ston pa po mdzad du gsol snyam pa dang*/ chos la zhes pa'i skabs su thugs rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i 'gog lam gyi bden pa gnyis dang*/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i chos kyi phung po sogs la dmigs te bdag skyabs dngos mdzad du gsol snyam pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun zhes pa'i skabs su/ skye mched/ yan lag phrin las yon tan sogs la dmigs te bdag gi skyabs bsgrub pa'i zla grogs mdzad du gsol snyam pa'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro'i tshig brgya stong la sogs pa brjod cing*/ khyad par du khrid kyi skabs skyabs khrid phog pa'i dgong mo brgya rtsa re nges can du dgos/ mthar bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che zhes sogs kyis slar yang gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i sku las 'od zer dmar po nyi ma'i 'od lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad la phog pas sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spyi dang khyad par du skyabs 'gro'i mi mthun phyogs su gyur pa'i sgo gsum gyi dri ma thams cad sangs kyis dag ste rang gi mtha' skor gyi sems can thams cad lus zag med rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku dang*/ yid rtog med chos kyi skur sangs rgyas te rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du bya khyu chen po 'phur ba bzhin du 'ur deng gis gshegs par bsam/

bla ma yang dbu gtsug tor dang gdan seng khri nas rim bzhin thugs kar 'od du zhu nas 'od dmar po'i phung po dmar ba la bltas na dmar ba'i mthar thug pa/ dwangs pa/ gsal ba/ mthong ba tsam gyis bde ba chen po bskyed nus pa gcig tu gyur te rang la thim pas bla ma'i thugs dang sems dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam pa ni kun rdzob pa'i skyabs 'gro yin la/ de'i ngang nas 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i rnam rtog gi rgyun rags pa thams cad la/ rang dus kyi shes pa had de ba de ga'i ngo bor cir gyis bltas pas/ sems kyi ngo bo nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dkyil lta bur gsal zhing sgrib pa med pa dge 'dun dkon mchog ngos bzung gi dmigs gtad thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa chen po chos dkon mchog de gnyis me dang me yis tsha ba bzhin du gsal stong zung du 'jug pa sangs rgyas dkon mchog ste gsum rang sems las logs su med par thag bcad nas de ga'i ngang du lus sems lhod kyis klod la mnyam par bzhag pa ni don dam pa'i skyabs 'gro'o// de ltar dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song bas/ sbyang gzhi tshe rabs grangs med pa nas skyabs su mi 'os pa'i 'jig rten pa'i lha mthu bo che dang 'jig rten gyi rgyal po chen po lta bur skyabs su song ba sogs kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i las 'bras bag chags thams cad sbyong byed yul khyad par can la skyabs su 'gro ba'i lam 'di nyams su blangs pas sbyangs 'bras sku gsum gyi go 'phang bde blag tu mngon par byed pa'o// de nas sems bskyed nas bzung bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sdud rim gyi bar mngon rtogs ji lta ba bzhin nyams su blangs la zhes pa lta bu'i tshig mdor bsdus kyi mtshams sbyar nas thun mthar mnyam par ma bzhag pa nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ gang zag spros bcas bskyed rim la dga' ba rnams de las thun mtshams kyi lhar lang la/ nyal ba'i tshe gnas khang chos 'byung dmar po 'od kyi rang bzhin can gyi dbus su rin po che'i khri'i steng du padma'i gdan/

de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de yang shin tu dro ba tsha tshi le ba zhig tu bsgom na gnyid mi yer ba'i dgos pa yod/ de'i steng du rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bu mo lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa rang gi mgo bo gang du gtad pa'i sar seng khri pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can du bzhugs pa'i sku pang ngam gdan la mgo gtad par bsam la blo g.yas 'og tu phab ste/ grogs rnams kyang tha mal gyi chags sdang skye ba'i yul ma yin par rang dang 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor mar bsgom/ de yang gnyid du ma song gi bar du/ res rang lha'i sku/ res spyi bo'i bla ma/ res gnas khang dang grogs sogs la dmigs pa res mos su gtad la nyal/ gang zag spros med rdzogs rim la mos pa rnams bsam mi khyab kyi sdud rim de ga'i ngang nas stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag bzhin du nyal ba'o// de ltar nyams su blangs pas sbyang gzhi snod kyi 'jig rten zhig pa/ bcud kyi sems can 'chi ba/ dge sbyor gyi 'dun pas rtsis ma zin par dud 'gro ltar sred pas nyal ba rnams sbyong byed nyal ba'i rnal 'byor 'di la brten nas sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa'o// de lta bu'i dmigs khrid rnams dang slar yang nyin phyi ma rnams kyi khrid dmigs rim pas bsnon pa khrid ma grol gyi bar thun bzhi'i nyams len chag med du bskyang bar nyams khrid ces pa'i tha snyad mdzad pa yin pas shin tu gal che'o// 'di yan gyis nyin dang po'i dmigs khrid rdzogs pa yin la/ de yang dang po rgyas pa/ bar du cung bsdus pa/ tha mar shin tu bsdus pa tshar gsum re mdzad/ nyin phyi mar slar yang nyin dang po'i khrid dmigs yang bskyar gcig dang de nas khrid phyi ma bsnon par mdzad pa nyin thams cad la rigs 'grel/ dper na nyin dang por khrid dmigs rgyas 'bring bsdus pa ste tshar gsum/

nyin gnyis par nyin dang po'i gsung bshad yang bskyar gyi thog nyin gnyis pa'i khrid dmigs rgyas pa gcig dang*/ slar nyin dang po'i yang bskyar dang bcas pa'i bshad pa 'bring bsdus gnyis nyin gsum par dang po dang gnyis pa gnyis kyi khrid yang bskyar thog gsum pa'i khrid dmigs rgyas pa gcig dang*/ slar nyin dang po gnyis kyi yang bskyar dang bcas pa'i gsung bshad 'bring bsdus gnyis re mdzad pa lta bu ste bzhi bshad kyi khrid tshul 'di slob bshad pa'i bshad rgyun la nges can du mdzad pa yin no/ ༈ /nyin gnyis pa'i khrid dmigs ni/ nyin dang po'i yang bskyar gyi thun mong ba'i dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ don che'i khrid kyi mthar/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i chos skor la nges par 'chi ba/ nam 'chi la nges pa med pa/ 'chi ba'i tshe chos las gzhan gyis mi phan par bsam pa las 'phros pa'i gsung bshad rgyas pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro'i khrid kyi mthar/ sa bcad gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis skye ba du mar rang gi pha mar ma byas pa gcig kyang med tshul gyi sgo nas mar shes/ ma nam byas kyi gnas skabs thams cad du thog mar zla ba dgu ngo mthong bcu'i bar du lus la bcangs/ bar du phyir btsas nas rol nang gi dud 'gro ltar nyam shin tu chung bas rim pas bskyed bsring dang*/ tha mar ma rang gi sha thang thang du bsags pa'i sa zhing nor rdzas thams cad rang la phog chos kyi sgor bcug pa sogs thog mtha' bar gsum du drin gyis bskyangs tshul gyi sgo nas drin dran pa/ ma rgan de dag thams cad 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang thabs la mi mkhas pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'bras kho na la longs spyod pas sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba sha stag yin/ des na de dag sdug bsngal las sgrol ba'i nus pa sangs rgyas kho na la yod pas/ bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las bsgral bar bya'o snyam du sems bskyed pa'i dmigs pa lung rigs dpyad pa du ma'i sgo nas gsal btab la sems bskyed kyi tshig ngag tu brjod/

de yang rgyun du tshar gang rigs dang*/ 'di'i nub mo brgya rtsa'am tha ma nyer gcig brjod pas kun rdzob byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed/ mthar mi dmigs pa'i lta bas rgyas 'debs pa ni don dam pa'i sems bskyed do// de ltar nyams su blangs pas sbyang gzhi sems can la dgrar bzung nas gnod par byed pa dang*/ rang nyid gcig pu zhi ba don du gnyer ba sogs sems bskyed kyi mi mthun phyogs thams cad sbyong byed kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i sems bskyed kyi nyams len la brten nas sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'grub pa'o// de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor nas bsdu rim bar mngon rtogs nyams su blangs rjes nyes pa lta bu'i tshig mdor bstan gyi mtshams sbyor nas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor spros bcas spros med gnyis kyi dmigs khrid bskyar/ de nas ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ sngar spros bcas bskyed rim gyi ngang nas nyal ba yin na/ sang zhog gnyid sad ma thag nam mkha' nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis ḍā ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra yi ge bdun pa dang*/ oṃ gsum ma'i gdangs su bsgrags gnyid bslang bar bsam la rang rnal 'byor ma'i sku sngar gsal btab pa bzhin yid du wal gyis dran par byed/ spros med du nyal ba yin na sngar bzhin sngags kyi sgras bslang ma thag stong nyid kyi ngang nas chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul gyis rnal 'byor mar bsgom nas spyod lam la 'jug go /nyin gnyis pa rdzogs so/ ༈ /nyin gsum par nyin snga ma rnams kyi thun mong ba'i khrid bskyar ba'i khar/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dkar nag gi las lam bcu'i ngo bo/ rnam smin bdag po'i rgyu mthun sogs kyi 'bras bu 'byin tshul bcas las 'bras kyi khrid rgyas pa thun mong ma yin pa skyabs sems kyi khrid bskyar ba'i mthar/ gsum pa 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i khrid la rang tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bor padma'i sdong po rtsa ba spyi bo'i tshangs bug nang du chud pa'i rtse mor padma dkar po'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/

de'i steng du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/ rdo rje dang dril bu bsnol mar 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing*/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ yab la phyag rgya drug dang*/ yum la phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yab rdo rje'i skyil krung dang yum gyi brla gnyis yab kyi sku sked nas 'khril ba'i sku rgyab tu zhabs mthil gnyis sprad pa padma'i skyil krung can/ gnyis ka'i spyi bor rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa phyed pa re res mtshan pa ni skabs 'dir yan lag bzhi rdzogs bsdus pa'i lugs yin pas ma chad pa gal che/ yab kyi thugs ka'i zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer phyogs thams cad 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad bdud rtsi dkar po'i rnam par char chen po babs pa bzhin spyan drangs te hūm̐ la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ yab kyi sku gang gsang ba nas brgyud rim bzhin yum gyi sku gang*/ yab yum gnyis ka'i sbyor mtshams dang sku'i cha thams cad nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun bsam gyis mi khyab pa babs/ padma'i sdong bu la 'khril ba'i tshul gyis tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang zhing*/ bdud rtsi 'ga' zhig dper na brag mthon po'i kha nas chu 'phyar 'babs pa bzhin padma'i sne rnams nas skya chil le babs/ lus kyi phyi thams cad bkrus par bsam/ de la thun mong ba'i dmigs pa gsum dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa bzhi las/ dang po ni/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun des sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam pa dang*/ nad thams cad rnag khrag 'ja' tshon ljan ljin dang*/ khyad par dug dang rims sogs rlangs pa sngon dmar 'tshubs cing 'khyil ba sogs kyi rnam pa dang*/ gdon thams cad srog chags sdom sdig sbrul sbal lcong sogs kyi rnam par 'og sgo dang rkang sor gyi rtse mo rnams nas dbyar gyi shwa 'od drag po'i sna sbur ma mi chags pa ltar sbyangs te phyir thon pa dang mnyam du mi dmigs par yal ba'i dmigs pa brtan po bya/

dngos nyams rmi lam sogs su lus las 'bu srin dang rnag khrag thon pa/ khrus byas shing nam mkhar 'phur ba rmi ba sogs sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags kyang 'di la brten nas 'byung bas las dang po pa'i skabs su gtso bor dmigs pa 'di la nan tan byed/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs pa bzhi ni/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun sngar ltar babs pas rang gi smin mtshams yan chad dang*/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang*/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag rdo rje sems dpa'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ de'i tshe dper na gangs ri'i rtse mor nyi ma shar ba'i tshe nyi 'od gang du phog pa yan chad shin tu dwangs shing gsal la de man chad cung zad mog pa'i rnam par 'byung ba bzhin rang gi smin mtshams yan chad kyi lus dwangs gsal dri bral gyi rnam pa can dang*/ de man chad cung zad mog por yod par bsam/ de bzhin du mgrin pa yan dang*/ longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang bas ngag gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying ga yan chad dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang bas yid kyi sdig sgrib sbyong*/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ rkang mthil yan chad dang sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong*/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus kyang yas mar sngar bzhin je dag je gsal du song nas shel gong g.ya' dag pa ltar gyur par bsam/ dmigs pa'i mdel kha gdags pa ni/ grang ba'i nad la bdud rtsi nyi ma'i 'od lta bu shin tu tsha bas grang ba'i nad thams cad sel bar byed pa dang*/ tsha ba'i nad la bdud rtsi kha dog dkar zhing shin tu bsil bas tsha ba thams cad sel bar byed pa/ rlung nad la bdud rtsi dmar ser mar gyi khu ba lta bu bcud dang ldan pas rlung nad thams cad sel bar byed pa dang*/

gdon gyi rigs la bdud rtsi khro chu khol ma lta bu'i gseb nas rta mgrin dang gsang bdag sogs khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par bsam/ dmigs pa kha bsgyur gyi zab gnad 'di rnams bla ma brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun zhal shes kho na las byung ba yin no// de lta bu'i dmigs pa rnams la gnad du bsnun bzhin par yi ge brgya pa brgya stong 'bum sogs brjod cing ma mtha' yang nyer gcig re chag med du bya/ de la dmigs tshan bdun po so sor yi ge brgya pa gsum re bzlas nas khyon nyer gcig gi grangs rdzogs shing dmigs pa rgyas bsdus mtshams pa yong*/ yi ge brgya pa yang thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud las/ rdo rje slob dpon gang gang gi /lhag pa'i lha ni gang gang la// dpal ni nges par sbyor bar bya// zhes gsungs pa'i lung la brten nas 'phags pa rin po ches/ badzra he ru ka'i mgor shrī sbyar bar mdzad pa ltar bzla/ mthar mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// zhes sogs kyi gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chag dag par byas zin gyis phyin chad sdig pa'i las ma byed cig ces gsung zhing 'od du zhu ste rang la thim pas rdo rje sems dpa' dang rang sems dbyer med du gyur par bsam la lta thog tu mnyam par bzhag pa ni don dam pa'i bshags pa bla na med pa'o// de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor man dkyus ltar nyams su blang la zhes bar gyi mtshams sbyar/ nyal ldang gi bskyar khrid kyi mthar/ bdud rtsi myong ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pa'i rjes su mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i ka pā la'am/ rgyun du mi rul ba'i khyad sogs kyi rdo sogs kyis byas pa'i thod pa'i snod du bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba'i chang la dmigs te/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/

oṃ zhes brjod pas stong par sbyangs/ āḥs thod pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang bar bskyed/ hūm̐ gis thod pa'i 'og nas rlung g.yos me rang 'bar du byung bas rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol/ hoḥs zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsir bsam la/ bdud rtsi sngar ma bsgrub pa'i gsar pa yin na brgya rtsa brjod cing*/ rgyun du lan gsum re brjod la byin gyis brlabs/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin rtse sbyar ba chos 'byung gi phyag rgyas nang mchod la g.yon skor du chos 'byung bri tshul byas pa'i dbus nas bdud rtsi blangs la myong bas mgrin pa gsung rdo rje lam brgyud/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim/ de'i rkyen gyis bam̐ yig nyi ma bye ba'i mdangs ltar 'od dang gzi brjid 'bar bas bde chen gyi ye shes skyes par bsam/ bdud rtsi ril bu dngos su yod na bdun re'am gsum re bza'/ des sbyang gzhi kha zas sogs la 'dod sred kyis kun nas bslang ste longs spyod pas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang*/ phyi rol pa kha cig lus bkrus pas sems kyi dri ma dag par 'dod pa dang*/ der ma zad 'dul ba dang rgyud sde 'og ma rnams nas kyang khrus dang gtsang sbra la brtson par gsungs pa rnams kyang thabs shes kyi nyams len khyad par can gyi rtsis ma zin na sangs rgyas myur du 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gro bar dka' bas/ sbyang gzhi de rnams sbyong byed bdud rtsi myong ba'i rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pas sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa'o// rgyud sde gzhan nas bshad pa'i dga' ba gsum gyi rnal 'byor yang 'di la 'dus pa yin te/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba sku'i dga' ba/ bdud rtsi mgrin pa gsung rdo rje'i lam brgyud de myong bas gsung gi dga' ba/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim pas lhan skyes bde chen rgyas pa thugs kyi dga' ba'o// nyin gsum pa rdzogs/ ༈ /nyin bzhi par sngon 'gro thun mong ba'i bskyar chos thog

'khor ba la nyes dmigs su lta ba'i gsungs bshad rgyas pa/ sngon 'gro thun mong ma yin pa'i bskyar chos thog bzhi pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid la thun mong ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngar skyabs 'gro'i skabs su gsal btab pa'i gnas khang gi rnam pa slar yang gsal gdab pa tsam gyi ngang nas/ de'i dbus su seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ de'i steng du sna tshogs padma dang zla ba nyi ma brtsegs pa'i gdan la ngo bo drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po gsal zhing dwangs pa/ g.yas bde stong gi chos sgra sgrog pa'i thod pa'i ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon de nyid nyams su blangs pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes rgyud la skyed pa mtshon pa'i ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ mchan khung g.yon du thabs shes zung du 'jug pa mtshon byed du kha ṭwāṃ ga 'chang ba mtshan dpes spras pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku can/ de yang skyabs 'gro'i skabs ltar skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo'am/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan khyad par can dran bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa'i skabs su bla ma'i thugs ka'i thad du yid dmigs rlung gsum gcig tu dril la khyed shes khyed mkhyen snyam pa'i 'dun pa rtse gcig tu gtad pas rang mos gus kyi stobs drag pos bla ma'i thugs kar thim la khad pa lta bur song bar bsam zhing*/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pa'i sne la mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros te phul bas thugs rgyud zag pa med pa'i bde bas mnyes par bsam/ bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes pa'i tshe/ bla ma'i sku las 'od zer gyi phung po chad de rang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/

gsol 'debs kyi tshig yid 'khul ba brgya stong sogs ci rigs brjod/ mthar bla ma gdan khri dang bcas pa yas mar gyi thugs ka'i thad du 'od dmar po'i gong bur zhu nas rang la thim pas bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du bltas la lta thog tu bzhag de nas 'phros rnams sa bcad tsam gyis mdor bsdu zhing ldang ba'i rnal 'byor sogs yang bskyar skabs phye/ nyin bzhi pa rdzogs/ ༈ /nyin lnga par/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gnyis 'bral 'chad dus zhal shes gsum// gsungs pa ltar las/ thog mar bla ma bskyed pa'i zhal shes thun mong ma yin pa ni/ sngar skyabs 'gro'i skabs su bskyed pa bzhin gyi gnas khang dag pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri rgya khyon shin tu yangs shing mtho ba/ de'i dbus su padma dang zla ba dang nyi ma'i gdan sum brtsegs kyi steng du drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/ de'i pad gdan gyi mdun nas 'og gi khri gcig po de ga'i steng du g.yon skor gyis brgyud pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i pad zla'i gdan la rim bzhin rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nas 'jam dbyangs nam mkha'i mtshan can gyi bar zab khrid thun mong ma yin pa'i brgyud pa dang*/ bla ma dam pa nas mkhan chen rgyal ba mchog dbyangs bar byin rlabs dang khrid lung thun mong ba'i brgyud pa yin pas brgyud pa gnyis ka ma chad par bsgom na legs shing*/ de nas brgyud pa gnyis ka chu bo gcig 'dres su bdag chen rdo rje 'chang la mnga' ba yin pas de man chad brgyud 'debs ltar gyi bla ma rnams dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du legs par gsal gdab/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams dang*/

khyad par tshe 'dir rang la chos 'brel yod do cog ste mdor na skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pa thams cad rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa re spyan drangs/ mdun gyi bla ma re re la skyabs gnas cha tshang ba re re thim pas thams cad skyabs kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can du gyur par bsam/ de yang dmigs pa gsal zhing yid 'khul ba ma byung gi bar du yang yang spyan 'dren cing bstim la rang gi lus zhing gi rdul snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam par sprul nas dngos su phyag 'tshal ba'am dmigs pa dang bcas gang drin ma dang*/ phyag byar 'os pa sogs brjod/ spro na brgyud 'debs kyang bya/ de nas skyabs yul rnams kyi mdun gzhal yas khang gi shar du rang nyid/ rang gi mdun du rang la gces shing 'phang pa'i nor rdzas longs spyod yod do cog thams cad khrom chen po'i tshong 'dus kyi zong ltar spung pa/ de rnams kyang rgyu kha dog dbyibs sogs sngar las bzang zhing phun tshogs par bsam/ rang gi g.yas nas brtsams te tshe 'di'i gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs/ lan chags pa'i 'byung po sogs mdor na gnod byed thams cad/ rang gi g.yon nas brtsams te tshe 'di'i pha ma nye 'brel/ mdza' bshes sogs gnyen rnams rang dang dgra gnyen gyi sems can de dag gi phyi rol du bar ma'i 'gro ba thams cad khrom tshogs pa bzhin 'khod par bsams la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bdag gi nor rdzas kyi dngos po thams cad 'bul bar bgyi'o// bdag 'dzin chags ser sna dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes rang gis bdag tu bzung ba'i nor rdzas longs spyod thams cad bla ma la phul bas rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa ser sna thams cad rang grol du song bar bsam/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bdag gi dgra thams cad 'bul bar bgyi'o// bdag zhe sdang dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes phul bas rang rgyud kyi zhe sdang thams cad rang grol du song bar bsam/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bdag gi gnyen thams cad 'bul bar bgyi'o// bdag 'dod chags dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes phul bas rang rgyud kyi 'dod chags thams cad rang grol du song bar bsam/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bdag gi bar ma'i sems can thams cad 'bul bar bgyi'o// bdag gti mug dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes phul bas rang rgyud kyi gti mug thams cad rang grol du song bar bsam pa ni zhen chags spang ba'o// mchod pa la phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ku sā li'i tshogs mchod maṇḍal dang drug las/ dang po ni/ de yang rgyu rang gi dus gsum du bsags zin pa dang gsog bzhin pa dang gsag par 'gyur ba'i dge rtsa ji snyed yod pa thams cad dang*/ der ma zad sgo gsum gyi mi dge ba'i las 'bras bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad kyang rgyu 'bras ngo bo bzang zhing gya nom pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba lta bu'i mchod pa'i sprin du sprul nas 'bul ba yin la/ ji ltar 'bul ba'i tshul ni rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo lang tsho dar zhing rgyan gyis mdzes pa dkar ser dmar ljang sogs kha dog sna tshogs pa phyag na dung phor gyi snod du chu gtsang yid du 'ong bar sman bzang po'i dri ro phun sum tshogs pas bgos pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te phul bar bsams la/ phyag rgya dang bcas oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod/ lha mo rnams slar rang gi snying gar bsdu/ de bzhin du spro bsdu'i dmigs pa phyag rgya dang bcas te/ zhabs bsil gyi chu gtsang dri ma med pa/ me tog sil ma dang*/ phreng ba spel ba ma rnying pa/ a ka ru dang du ru ka la sogs pa'i bdug spos/

gser la sogs pa'i snod du rtsi mar gyi mar me/ chu gtsang la ga bur gur gum sihla sogs nus pa bsil zhing dri zhim pa sman sbyar ba'i dri chab/ lha mi'i bza' bca' phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa'i zhal zas/ pi waṃ gling bu rdza rnga sogs snyan pa'i dbyangs 'byin pa'i rol mo dang bcas pa sprul la pā dyaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyi mchod/ gzhan yang spro na 'dod yon lnga/ bkra shis pa'i rtags rdzas brgyad/ rgyal srid kyi rin po che dang nye ba'i rin chen bdun sogs kyang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya tsam mam tshig bcad so so'i sngags bcas rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas phul/ gnyis pa nang mchod ni/ slar yang snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsis bkang ba'i ka pā la thogs pa du ma spros te 'bru gsum brjod la nang mchod phul/ gsum pa gsang mchod ni/ snying ga nas spros pa'i padma can sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya mdzes shing lta bas mi ngom pa rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i dang por snyan pa'i glu dang mdzes pa'i gar bsgyur ba'i mthar thams cad kyang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur te bla ma rnams dang mnyam par sbyor bas zag pa med pa'i lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po sku nyams su bstar bas mnyes par bsams la rang gi yang 'khyud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badzra swā bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pa ni rang rgyud la rjes chags kyi nga rgyal mi bskyed kyang mchod yul rnams bde bas mnyes pa'i dmigs pa brtan pa'i ched du yin no// bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ mchod bya/ mchod byed/ mchod rdzas thams cad rang bzhin grub pas stong pa'i lta thog tu mnyam par bzhag la mchod pa'i 'khor gsum mi dmigs pas rgyas gdab 'phros mdor bsdus/ nyin lnga pa rdzogs/ ༈ /nyin drug par/ lnga pa ku sā li'i tshogs bsags pa ni/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i rnam par shes pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur lam gyis gyur pa skad cig gis tshangs bug nas spyi gtsug gi nam mkhar rgyang gis thon phung po cung zad rgyab tu phyogs pa'i steng gi thad nas mar bltas pas/

rang gi phung po rnying pa de nyid che zhing snum pa zhig tu mthong bas de snga phan chad 'khor bar rnam smin gyi phung po ji snyed cig blangs pas thams cad don med pa dang*/ don log pa 'ba' zhig tu song 'dug da res lus rten 'di la brten nas bsod nams rlabs po che bsog par bgyi'o snyam la rang gi snying ga nas rnal 'byor ma gcig rgyang gis spros te las byed pa'am/ yang na rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i phyag g.yas pa'i gri gug gis phung po de'i smin mtshams dang rna ltag g.yas g.yon rnams su reg pas thod pa ling gis kog khri'i mdun dang dpung pa gnyis kyi bar du skad cig thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi dbus su rlung ljang nag rab tu g.yo ba'i steng me gru gsum du 'bar ba bcas rab tu byung*/ thod pa de thod sgyed gsum gyi khar bzhag gri gug gis phung po'i dang po rkang mgo gnyis/ de nas rkang pa dang lag pa g.yas g.yon rnams dum bu gsum rer gtub la thod par bskyur 'phros kyi phung po yang sha dum rus dum du gtub la thod par spung pas sha rus kyi ri bo dang*/ khrag zhag gi rgya mtsho chen pos phyur bur gang bar bsam/ 'og gi rlung g.yos pas me cher 'bar thod pa'i rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol/ de'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ āḥdamar po/ oṃ dkar po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs mar gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang khams gsum gyi bcud thams cad bdud rtsi 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs pa yi ge gsum la thim zhing yi ge gsum yang 'od du zhu nas rdzas la thim/ ma dag pa'i skyon gyi dngos po rnams phyir lud pa me lces lhag med du bsreg pas rdzas rnams bdud rtsi kha dog dkar zhing ro sbrang rtsi ltar mngar ba/ nus pas shi nas zhag bdun lon pa'ang gso bar nus shing rlangs pa las grub pa'i rtags g.yung drung dang dga' ba 'khyil pa sogs gzugs 'char ba zhig tu bsams la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥzhes phyag rgya dang bcas lan gsum byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas lha mo phyag na thod pa thogs pa bdun rim pa bzhin du spros pa rnams kyis mdun gyi bdud rtsi las bcus/ rtsa ba'i bla ma yab yum la phul bar bsams la/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lan bdun du phul bas kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i rten 'brel khyad par can 'byung la/ rgyas par spro na brgya stong sogs blo dang 'tshams par phul/ de nas lha mo re re spro zhing bsdu ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams re re'i mtshan gyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas 'bul ba'am/ yang na bla ma rnams kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i lha mo spros la/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lan gsum mam lnga sogs ci rigs pas phul/ bla ma rnams kyi steng dang*/ phyogs mtshams thams cad du skyabs yul zhi khro rab 'byams yod do cog thams cad kyang mgron thabs su bzhugs par bsam la phul bas mchod yul thams cad bde ba chen pos dgyes par bsam/ 'og gzhir 'khod pa'i rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la yang ci 'dod par sbyin pa de dag gis myong ba tsam gyis sgrib gnyis ma lus pa byang ste rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur sangs rgyas nas dag pa'i zhing khams so sor gshegs par bsam/ rang la pha rol gyi rbod gtong drag po zug pa'am/ lha 'dre sogs kyi gnod pas gtses pa yod na/ slar yang rang la gnod byed gang yin pa de dag chos nyid kyi bden pa'i stobs kyis bkug pas thams cad skad cig gis 'jigs 'jigs rngam rngam ltar lhags par bsams la bdud rtsi de nyid sha khrag longs spyod rin po che sogs yid la ji ltar 'dod pa'i rdzas su gyur par longs spyod pas ci bder tshim nas gdug rtsub gnod sems thams cad zhi nas phan pa dang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan nas mthar thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur sangs rgyas par bsam/

de ltar rang lus kyi sbyin pa rgya chen pos sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'khod song*/ dga' ba la ang snyam pa'i spro ba bskyed/ ༈ drug pa maṇḍal gyi khrid/ maṇḍal gyi rgyu rin po che la sogs las grub pa la 'bru dkar gtsang ma dri bzang gi chus sbags pa'i tshom bu bkod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs grangs mang bar phul/ de yang dngos 'byor gyi mchod pa gzhan rnams la dang po rtsol ba'i dri ma/ dngos gzhi la ser sna'i dri ma/ rjes rlom sems kyi dri ma ste dri ma gsum 'byung bar 'dir dri ma de dag mi 'byung bas mchod pa'i gtso bo yin no// maṇḍal dngos su med na sngar bdud rtsi'i lhag ma thod pa sgyed pu bcas skad cig gis maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab lha mi'i dpal 'byor ma tshang ba med pa gcig tu lam gyis gyur par bsams la 'bul/ de ltar mchod pas sbyang gzhi tshe rabs thog med nas yul mtho ba sangs rgyas nas/ dma' ba 'bu srin phra mo yan chad kyi bar thams cad la brnyas shing smod pa ma gus par log par bltas pa sogs kyi las ji snyed bsags pa rnams skabs 'dir yul mchog dman thams cad mchod pa'i yul bsod nams kyi zhing du byas te mchod pa phul ba'i rnal 'byor 'dis sbyangs pas 'bras bu mtshan dpes spras pa'i gzugs kyi sku khyad par can 'grub par byed pa'o// 'phros mdor bsdus yang bskyar skabs phyi nyin drug pa rdzogs/ ༈ /nyin bdun par/ gnyis pa dbang blang ba'i zhal shes ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas gtso bo bla ma yab yum gyis dbang bskur mi bskur gnang ba zhu ba'i tshul gyis brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la spyan khor gyis gzigs pas de rnams kyis kyang dbang bskur zhig ces pa'i brdar thams cad kyis gtso bo la spyan cher gyis gzigs/

de nas bla ma gong ma gong ma'i byin gyis brlabs kyi chu bo 'og ma 'og mar chad pa med par zhugs pa'i brdar rdo rje 'chang rje btsun rnal 'byor mar thim ste paṇa chen nā ro ta pa nas bzung rim pas mthar mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub la thim/ de yang gtso bo rtsa ba'i bla ma yab yum la thim par bsam pa'am/ yang na mtha' nas rim bzhin rdo rje 'chang gi bar bsdus te gtso bo la thim par mos pa gang byas kyang khyad par med/ de nas bla ma yab yum gyi spyi bo nas 'od zer bdud rtsi dkar po'i sne la oṃ yig dkar po'i phreng ba oṃ gyi rang sgra sgrog bzhin pa byung*/ rang gi smin mtshams nas zhugs te lus thams cad mer gyis kheng pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku'i byin rlabs dang bum pa'i dbang thob/ dbang dus kyi nyams dga' ba'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ mgrin pa dang thugs ka nas kyang rim pa bzhin 'od dang bdud rtsi dmar po dang sngon po'i sne la āḥdang hūm̐ gi phreng ba rang sgra sgrog bzhin par byung*/ rang gi mgrin pa dang snying ga nas rim gyis zhugs/ ngag dang yid kyi sgrib pa dag gsung dang thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ mchog tu dga' ba dang dga' bral gyi ye shes skyes/ slar yang bla ma'i gnas gsum ka nas 'od zer bdud rtsi yig 'bru dang bcas pa dkar dmar mthing ka'i tshogs gcig char du byung*/ rang gi gnas gsum nas zhugs te lus thams cad gang bas sgo gsum gyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong*/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lhan skyes kyi dga' ba khyad par can rgyud la skyes par bsam/ de dag ni rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa las/ gzhan gyi brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar yul khyad par can la brten nas bsod nams kyi tshogs mngon par 'du bya ba'i rim pa'o// gsum pa bla ma bstim pa'i zhal shes ni/

slar yang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol 'debs kyi mos gus drag po byas pas bla ma de yang dbu'i gtsug tor nas mar 'od du zhu/ gdan seng khri dang bcas pa nas yar 'od du zhu nas mthar thugs ka'i thad du 'od kyi phung po chen po dmar ba la bltas nas dmar ba'i mthar thugs pa mthong ba tsam gyis bde ba chen po'i ye shes bskyed nus pa zhig tu lam gyis gyur/ de nyid rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim/ de nyid je cher song ste mthar rang lus stong gsum gyis khams thams cad kyang bam̐ yig gi rnam par gyur pa la sems bzung*/ de yang nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa bzhin yal bar bsam la de ga'i ngang nas stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin bla ma chos kyi sku/ gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid bla ma sprul pa'i sku/ zung 'jug sems kyi ngo bo bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste rang sems skad cig ma 'di dag bla ma sku gsum gyi ngo bor thag bcad ngo shes par byas te gshis skye med stong nyid du rjen ne ba/ gdangs 'gags med mos gus su lam me bar lta thog tu mnyam par bzhag 'phros mdor bsdus/ nyin bdun pa rdzogs/ ༈ /nyin brgyad par/ de ni tshogs gnyis las ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'i yan lag yin la/ de'i sbyang gzhi ni gzhi dus su las kyi dbang gis rags rlung sems kyi rgyu ba mtha' dag rim gyis 'gag ste gzhi'i 'od gsal la 'jug pa'i las nyon gyi dbang gis ma dag pa'i 'chi ba 'byung ba de nyid sbyong byed bde stong gi ye shes la mnyam par bzhag pa'i lam 'dis sbyong zhing sbyangs 'bras lam dus su rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor bsgom stobs kyi mthus rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pas gzhi dang lam gyi 'od gsal mngon du byed cing*/ mthar thug dag pa ye shes kyi sku 'grub par byed pa'i tshul du sbyangs pa yin no// de yan ni 'di nyid kyi lam rim smon lam las/

dal 'byor gru chen mi rtag dran pa yi// zhes pa nas/ rje btsun bla ma'i thugs rjes bskyong bar shog /ces pa'i bar gyi shlau ka gnyis kyi don te thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i lam gyi rim pa'o// dngos gzhi bdag lhar bskyed pa la/ spyir bskyed rim gyi sbyang gzhi la/ rgya che ba/ zab pa/ mthar thug pa dang gsum las/ 'dir ni sangs rgyas kyi thugs rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes su 'gyur rung ngam rang sems lhan cig skyes pa ste mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi'o// sbyong byed kyi lha la dbye na/ 'og min gyi zhing na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ni lhan skyes kyi rnal 'byor ma/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi sogs su sa dang lam gyi khyad par ci rigs la bzhugs pa'i dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma rnams ni zhing skyes kyi rnal 'byor ma/ 'dzam bu gling gi yul dang yul gru rnams su mkha' 'gro ma'i rigs las skyes pa'i bud med thams cad las las skyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ rang dang sems can thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur bskyed pa ni sngags skyes kyi rnal 'byor ma ste phyi'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'o// rang gi lus kyi lte bar ma las thob pa'i khams dmar po gnyis dwangs dang sum dwangs kyis gang ba'i rtsa mdun gru gsum a thung shad kyi rnam pa can gyi skyes tsher mgo mjug ldog pa lta bu chos 'di pa'i lugs la bam̐ yig gi rnam par gnas pa ni nang gi rnal 'byor ma/ de nyid bla mas byin rlabs kyi dus su ting lo sbyin pa'i brda thabs kyi sgo nas ngo sprad pa'i rkyen gyis dbang dus su skyes pa'i bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni gsang ba'i rnal 'byor ma ste phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sbyong byed lha'i dbye ba'o// de lta bu'i dbang gi ye shes de nyid chag med du nyams len gyi rgyun bskyangs pas sgrub pa po'i nang rdo rje lus kyi rtsa dang khams rten gnas dang brten pa lha'i ngo bor bzhugs pa dang*/

phyi'i gnas yul dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gnad kyis/ thog mar las las skyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*/ de nas zhing skyes dang*/ lhan skyes kyis byin gyis brlabs pas bde stong gi ye shes khyad par can myur ba nyid du mngon sum du 'char bar 'gyur bas byin gyis yas brlabs/ rtog pa mas nas 'char ba'o// de ltar sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs par ngo 'phrod par byas la/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i snying gar e e las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs/ de yang 'og ma dmar gtor khog stong mgo mjug ldog pa lta bu dang*/ steng ma gdan thabs kyi rnam pa can/ de'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar 'khyil le ba'i lte bar bam̐ yig dmar po zla ba'i dbus yang bam̐ yig gi mdangs kyis dmar shig ge ba/ de'i mdun nas g.yon skor du oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog dmar po rang sgra sgrogs shing 'od kyi phreng bas bskor ba/ chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' 'khyil re re/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ lus thams cad gang bas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag lus kyang 'od dmar po'i phung po gcig tu gyur/ chos 'byung zla ba sngags phreng 'od phung dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang skad cig gis rnal 'byor ma'i skur cho ga ltar bskyed la bzlas pa'i bar bya/ de nas sems 'dzin la/ nga rgyal la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ gsal snang la sems 'dzin pa gnyis/ dang po las rang lha'i skur gsal ba la dmigs nas/ nga ni tha mal pa nam yang ma yin gyi/ skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos yin snyam du lha'i nga rgyal brtan po bskyed la mnyam par bzhag bying ba dang rgod pa sogs kyi rkyen byung tshe sngar bzhin nga rgyal bzung ba la bslabs/ thun las ldang bar 'dod na bsam mi khyab sdud rim gyi mthar thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang la go cha'i bsrung ba bya/

'phros mdor bsdus dang yang bskyar skabs phye/ nyin brgyad pa rdzogs/ ༈ /nyin dgu par nyin snga ma'i lus kyang 'od dmar po'i phung po gcig tu gyur zhes pa'i mtshams nas/ de ltar rang lus stong gsal du sbyangs nas bdag bskyed kyi rnal 'byor ma bsgom pa'i bar der slar yang tha mal pa'i rnam par ldang ba'i lus de ni/ gzhi dus su lus rten snga ma dor/ phyi ma ma blangs pa'i bar gyi srid pa bar dor skye 'gyur gyi lus dang chos mtshungs la/ sbyang gzhi ni/ de lta bu'i bar srid du skye ba blang nas rten der/ 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi nyam nga'i g.yang sa gsum/ ma nges pa'i rtags drug sogs 'jigs skrag gi 'khrul pa'i snang bas bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal ji snyed cig myong 'gyur rnams dang gzhan yang 'khor bar skye 'gyur gyi las nyon bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed skabs 'dir snying ga'i chos 'byung*/ zla ba sngags phreng bam̐ yig dang bcas pa bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor gyis sbyong zhing*/ sbyangs 'bras lam dus su phyag rgya chen po dbu mar zhugs pas kun 'dar gsang spyod dang phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa'i rten du yod pa'i 'ja' lus sgyu ma'i sku khyad par can dang*/ mthar thug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub par byed pa yin la ma rgyud kyi zab gnad bdag gzhan gyi gzhi sbyong ba dang bsgyur ba'i nang nas bdag gi sbyor ba yang 'dir tshang ba yin no// de nas rang lhar bskyed pa nas nga rgyal la sems bzung ba'i bar mdor bsdus/ gnyis pa gsal snang la sems 'dzin pa la sku spyi la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ bye brag la sems 'dzin pa'o// dang po la/ nga ni tha mal pa nam yang ma yin la 'bras dus bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal ci nus bskyed pa de'i ngang nas/ de lta bu'i rnal 'byor ma de yang sku mdog dmar mo g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/

'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi gdan la zhabs brkyang bskum gyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan cha skya khrol le ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o snyam pa tsam gyi sgo nas sku'i rnam pa spyi tsam la gsal snang thon pa sems bzung*/ 'phros mdor bsdus yang bskyar skabs phye/ nyin dgu pa rdzogs/ ༈ /nyin bcu par/ nyin snga ma'i bdag gi gzhi sbyangs pa yang 'dir tshang ba yin no'i mtshams nas de ltar bdag gi gzhi dang bar do bcas sbyangs pa'i rnal 'byor de nyid la skye ba phyi ma 'khor ba'i gnas gang du skye 'gyur gyi skye gnas bzhi sbyong tshul tshang ba yin te/ chos 'byung gis ni skye gnas bzhi ka'i gang du skye ba'i gnas/ zla ba'i mtha'i dkar cha dang*/ dbus bam̐ yig gi 'od kyis dmar mdangs su yod pas mngal skyes dang sgong skyes gnyis kyi pha ma'i khu khrag gi dod brlan gsher dang drod rnams sbyangs/ bam̐ yig gi skye gnas bzhi gang nying mtshams sbyor 'gyur gyi rnam par shes pa/ 'od zer spro sbyangs kyis mngal skyes kyi lus chag nas ma btsas bar du mngal gyi gnas skabs rim gyis 'phel la/ lus 'od kyi gong bur bsgyur bas sgong skyes la sgo nga'i gzugs chags pa/ lha'i skur langs pas mngal sgong gnyis la phyir btsa' ba dang*/ gzhan gnyis kyi gzugs rag pa grub pa rnams te/ skye gnas kyi ma dag pa rnams ji ltar sbyang ba'i tshul yin la/ dag pa mngon par byang chub pa lnga las bskyed tshul gyi gnad kyang 'dir sbyar du yod de chos 'byung gi gzhi stong pa nyid las byang chub pa/ zla bas gdan pad zla la byang chub pa/ sngags phreng gis gsung yig 'bru las byang chub pa/ bam̐ yig gi lto ba gri gug gi so lta bur gnas pas thugs phyag mtshan las byang chub pa/ rang rnal 'byor mar bskyed pas sku rdzogs pa las byang chub pa'o// de nas rang gi lus 'od phung du gyur pa de yang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur lam gyis gsal gdab ste/

sgrub pa po 'khor bar gnas kyang 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos pa mtshon pa'i sna tshogs padma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa'i kha dog dang dri bsung phun sum tshogs pa da lta kha bye ma thag pa lta bu/ de'i steng du byang chub kyi sems sogs kyang dkar chos kyi yon tan thams cad smin cing gong du 'phel ba mtshon pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rgyu rin po che me shel las grub pa dmar ser 'od kyi phung po dbyibs zlum gyi le ba/ de'i steng du rang nyid nges don du rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma/ rnam pa 'bras dus bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar bzhugs pa'i mkha' spyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lhan skyes sprul pa'i sku'i rnam par shar ba/ chos sku bde ba chen po'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad kyang ma dag pa 'khor ba'i gnas su sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs pa'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pas zhi ba myang 'das kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa mtshon pa'i zhabs g.yas thabs kyi rang bzhin brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i 'dod chags kyi gnas nu ma nas mnan pa/ don dam par rnam par rtog pa'i spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i myang 'das chos kyi sku'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad pas srid pa 'khor ba'i mthar mi gnas pa mtshon pa'i zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed ste dbang phyug nag po gdong gcig pa lag pa bzhi'i dang po gnyis gri thod/ lhag ma gnyis cang te'u dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa kha sbub tu byas pa'i/ zhe sdang gi gnas snying ga'i thad kyi rgyab tu/ gti mug gi gnas spyi bo lteb pa'i/ phrag dog gi gnas dpral ba nas mnan pa/ de gnyis ka shi ba'i ro gdan lta bu ma yin par nga rgyal gyi dregs pa dang bral nas dbugs rgyu nus tsam du gnas pa nyon mongs pa lnga ma lus pa bcom zhing*/ lha chen yab yum 'jig rten gyi lha mthu bo che kun gyi gtso bor gyur pa gdan du mdzad pas khams gsum las rgyal ba mtshon pa/

sems can la rjes su chags pa mtshon pa'i so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi rang mdangs sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me'i phung po dang mtshungs pa'i gzi brjid can/ chos thams cad don dam zung 'jug stong pa nyid kyi dbyings su ro gcig pa mtshon pa'i zhal gcig bden gnyis mtshon pa'i phyag gnyis/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa'i drwa ba rtsad nas gcod pa'i brdar phyag g.yas thur du shad kyis brkyangs pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed pa'i yu ba can gyi zangs kyi gri gug 'jol thabs su 'dzin cing*/ 'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i brdar ngo bo bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin la rnam pa bdud bzhi'i khrag dmar pos yongs su gang ba'i ka pā la phyag g.yon pas gyen du btegs pa'i tshul gyis bsnams nas zhal du dmar chi li li gsol ba dus gsum gyi ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i chos thams cad ma 'dres sgrib med du gzigs pa mtshon pa'i spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod kyi zhing du hrig ge gzigs pa thab he ru ka dang 'bral ba med pa mtshon pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po ḍā ma ru dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma rang nyid kyi sku tshad dang mnyam pa phrag pa g.yon par rtse rgyab dang rtsa ba mdun du brten nas bkal bar g.yon pa'i gru mor 'khyud pa'i rnam pa can/ de lta bu'i kha ṭwāṃ ga des yab he ru ka'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa mtshon pa yin te/ rtsa ba rdo rje phyed pas brgyan pas srung ba'i 'khor lo rdo rje'i gur mda' yi drwa ba ye shes kyi me dang bcas pa mtshon/ yu ba rgyu rus pa la byas shing kha dog dkar ba dbyibs smad phra la rtse mo sbom shing ldir ba brgyad gzhog gi rnam pa can du byas pas dur khrod brgyad/ der gnas pa'i mchod rten sogs dur khrod kyi mtshan nyid thams cad brgyad mtshan du gnas pa mtshon/ sna tshogs rdo rjes gzhal yas khang gi gdan gyi sna tshogs rdo rje/

bum pas gzhal yas khang sgo mtshams brgyad kyi lha dang bcas pa/ khrid yig 'ga' zhig tu thod pa skam rlon rnyid pa sogs gsung kyang 'dir thod skam dkar dmar mthing gsum brtsegs pas sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams dang*/ rtse mor rdo rje sngon po sgang pos mtshan pas gtso bo dang snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi bcas mtshon la/ de'i mgul du btag pa'i ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pas sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phrin las bcas mtshon par byed do// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching ba thams cad las grol ba mtshon pa'i dbu skra nag cing snum pa nyag ma re re yang ma 'dzings par thur du grol bas sku sked yan chad sil le khyab pa mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba bcu drug rgyas pa mtshon pa'i nu 'bur rgyas shing bde ba bskyed pa'i nyams dang ldan pa 'di nas nyin snga ma'i sku'i rnam pa spyi tsam la gsal snang thon par sems bzung ba'i bar mdor bsdu/ gnyis pa bye brag la sems 'dzin pa yang*/ rgyan can la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ rgyan med la sems 'dzin pa gnyis las/ dang po spyan gsum dbus mar sems bzung ba ni/ rang gi dpral bar spyan dbus ma/ dbus nag la mtha' skya ba/ spyan rtsa dmar shig ge ba/ spyan g.yon pa gyen du bslang ba lta bu/ de'i 'gram du smin ma nag khyug ge ba/ de yang khro bo'i spyan lta bu ha cang bsgrad pa ma yin pa la/ zhi ba'i spyan lta bu yang ma yin pa/ spyan gyi dbus sbom zhing mjug phra la ring ba zhig la sems gtad de mi gsal na/ ngag tu spyan gyi khyad par de dag brjod cing gsal btab/ des kyang mi gsal na/ de lta bu'i ri mo bris pa mdun du bzhag la yang yang lta ba'am/ bris pa de rang gi dpral bar sbyar la me long sogs la bltas nas bsgom/ 'phros mdor bsdus yang bskyar skabs phye/ nyin bcu pa rdzogs/ ༈ /bcu gcig par bde ba bskyed pa'i nyams dang ldan pa zhes pa'i mtshams nas/

dbu'i skra mtshams nas bai ḍūrya'i 'khyud mo gser gyis spras pa bcings par de bzhin gshegs pa lnga mtshon pa'i thos pa skam po bum ril ma yin pa'i leb mo sor mo bcu gnyis par kha mig sogs bris pa'i rnam pa can/ de bsgom mi bde na/ rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa las/ thod pa leb mo sor lnga pa'i// zhes sogs kyi dgongs pa bzhin/ tshad sor lnga pa lnga'i dbu rgyan la dbus ma'i rtse mor 'khor lo dkar po/ g.yas ngos gnyis la rim pas rdo rje sngon po/ rin po che ser po/ g.yon ngos gnyis la padma dmar po/ rgya gram ljang gu/ de thams cad kyi mtha' gser gyi pa tras mdzes par bsdam pa/ nang gi ā li kā li ste khams dkar dmar gyi cha rnam par dag pa mtshon pa'i thod skam lnga bcu ro skra'i srad bu la brgyus pa'i do shal can/ 'di yang bla ma 'ga' zhig gis mgo rlon gyi phreng ba mdzad pa zab gnad yin pa ltar gsungs kyang tshad ldan mkhas pa gong ma rnams kyi yi ge dang gsung sgros dag tu thod skam du bshad pa ltar slob bshad thun mong min pa'i bzhed pa'ang de kho na'o// spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i rtsibs bar rnams nas dbu skra yar thon zhing rtsibs kyi rtse mo nas rus phreng gi drwa ba sum cu rtsa gnyis 'phyang ba/ dbu gtsug 'khor lo'i lte bar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rigs kyi bdag po rnam snang he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa thod skam lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ spyi bor rdo rje phyed pa dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pas dbu brgyan pa/ de yang dbang lha spyan drangs nas dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ rigs bdag rang chas su bsgom pa gnyis las/ 'dir ni lugs phyi ma bzhin te/ dper na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po la bu mang du yod pa'i dmangs rnams rgyal po dang khyad med du bskur ba'i yul du mi 'gyur la/

rgyal po bu gcig pu rgyal srid la dbang bskur bar nges pa de ni rgyal po ltar kun gyis mchod pa'i yul du byed pa dang chos mtshungs pa'o// snyan gnyis la rus pa'i a long gnyis gshibs kyi rnam pa can gyi snyan rgyan rtse mor rus pa'i pa tras mdzes pa/ mgul tu rus pa'i gzhung dbus dang g.yas g.yon gnyis te gsum gyi bar du rus phreng gis sbrel ba las drwa ba bcu drug dang*/ bar bar drwa ba phyed pa'i za ra tshag 'phyang ba/ sku sked du rus pa'i gzhung lnga la phan tshun rus phreng gis sbrel ba las drwa ba drug cu rtsa bzhi za ra tshag dang bcas pa 'phyang ba'i ring ba rnams zhabs kyi long bu/ bar pa rnams byin pa thung ba rnams zhabs pus slebs pa phyag gi dpung pa dang mkhrig ma/ zhabs kyi long bu'i mtshams rnams su rus pa'i gzhung gsum re phan tshun rus phreng gis sbrel ba'i gdu bu ste phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa tshangs skud dang se ral kha ni shes rab ma mtshon byed yin pas mi dgos so// de nas bar rnams mdor bsdus la/ spyan dbus ma'i sems 'dzin gyi mthar spyan gnyis kyi khyad chos spyan dbus ma lta bu/ spyan gnyis kyi bar smin mtshams su gnyer ma dbus su ri mo dod tsam dang g.yas g.yon du che ba re/ shangs kyi rtsa ba phra zhing rtse mo gzengs mtho ba/ shangs bug dmar sang nge ba/ zhal gyi sgros legs shing mchu bim ba ltar dmar ba/ de'i nang du tshems phreng bzhi bcu mu tig gi 'phreng ba bzhin dkar la thag bzang zhing mche ba cung zad 'bur ba/ zhal ha cang gdangs pa ma yin par he byas pa lta bu/ snyan shal ring zhing mdzes pa la shog rgyas pa/ 'di nas bar rnams mdor bsdus nas/ sdud rim rjes thun mtshams kyi lhar lang la g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis phyogs bzhir shar nas brtsams te g.yon skor du se gol gtogs pa dang bcas sumbha ni sogs brjod pas shar dang steng gnyis kar kha gdong ma re re/ oṃ gṛhṇa sogs brjod pas/

byang du 'ug gdong ma/ oṃ gṛhṇa pa ya sogs brjod pas nub dang 'og gnyis la khyi gdong ma re re/ oṃ a na sogs brjod pas lhor phag gdong ma/ mtshams rnams la yang shar lho nas g.yas skor du sngags dang phyag rgya'i tshul des gshin rje brten ma/ pho nya mo/ mche ba ma/ 'joms ma rnams kyi sku re lam gyis grub par bsam/ slar yang sngags tshar gcig brjod pas phyi rol dpag tshad brgya'i tshod tsam las/ rdo rje'i gur/ mda'i drwa ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor gzhom gzhig dang bral bas bgegs dang bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshug par bsam/ 'phros mdor bsdus/ yang bskyar skabs phye/ bcu gcig pa rdzogs/ ༈ /bcu gnyis par/ nyin snga ma'i shes rab ma mtshon byed yin pas mi dgos pa'i mtshams nas sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me bskal pa'i me'i phung po ltar 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de ltar rang lha'i sku rdzogs par bsgom pa'i sbyong byed kyi rnal 'byor 'dis/ sbyang gzhi las nyon gyi dbang gis 'khor bar nying mtshams sbyar nas ma dag pa rigs drug gang rung gi lus 'grub pa sbyangs shing*/ sbyangs 'bras dag pa lha'i sku dang rnam pa mthun pa'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa'i rigs 'dra'i rgyu las mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i sku 'grub par byed pa yin no// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying gar chos 'byung zla ba sngags phreng bam̐ yig dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal btab la/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas snod thams cad kyi ma dag pa sbyangs te ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang chos kyi 'byung gnas dmar po'i rnam pa dang*/ bcud kyi sems can rnams kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs te thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku 'ba' zhig tu lam gyis gyur par bsam/ des ni gzhan gyi gzhi sbyong zhing bsgyur ba yin no// de nas/ dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs pa/

ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa la gang gis spyan 'dren pa/ gang spyan 'dren pa/ gang nas spyan 'dren pa/ tshul ji ltar spyan 'dren pa'o// dang po ni rang lha'i skur gsal ba de nyid spyan 'dren pa po yin la/ gnyis pa gang spyan 'dren pa ni pho nya mchog 'bring tha ma gsum ste/ pho nya mchog 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ 'bring 'dzam bu gling gi gnas yul du dur khrod rnams kyi zhing skyes kyi rnal 'byor ma/ tha ma yul dang grong khyer dag tu las dang rigs las skyes pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyis 'gro ba thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur bskyed pa'i sngags skyes kyi rnal 'byor ma rnams so// gsum pa gang nas spyan 'dren pa ni/ spros bral chos kyi sku ste rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gzugs kyi sku'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa yin la/ bzhi pa tshul gang gis spyan 'dren pa ni/ sngags dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gsum las/ dang po ni/ phaiṃ/ zhes ngag tu brjod la de yang bod skad du khos zhes pa'i don de spyan 'dren pa'i dus 'dir mi 'byon na mgo bo khos shig ces dam tshig gi dmod pa bor ba'i mkha' 'gro ma'i srog sngags yin/ de yang pha dang e dang ma gsum ka'i rang gdangs tshang bar ring ba'i tshul gyis brjod/ gnyis pa ni rkang pa g.yon pa'i mtheb chen g.yas pa'i mtheb chen gyis mnan/ lag pa'i mthe bong gnyis thur du brkyangs la rtse sprad/ mdzub mo gnyis mdud/ gung mo gnyis brkyangs la rtse sbyar/ lhag ma rnams 'bar ba ltar byas pa'i ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i phyag rgya g.yon nas gyen du btegs la mig steng du bsgyur ba'i lta stangs dang bcas dpral ba'i dbyings g.yon du lan gsum bskor ba ste/ rgyud a bhi dha na las/ mdzub mo mdud byas gung mo nges par sbyar// mthe bong rdo rje brtan por rab tu sbyar// de yi dpral ba'i dbus su rab bzhag nas// bskor zhing bskor nas kun tu bskor ba bya// rkang pa mnan cing steng du lta// gyen du phaiṃ gyi sgra sgrogs shing*// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams 'gugs// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gsum pa ni rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/

smin mtshams sam/ snying ga'i thad sor gang yang rung ba nas phyir thon te phyogs mtshams thams cad khyab par 'phros pas/ ye shes pa thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul nas steng nas byon pa rnams dbyar gyi char sprin 'thibs pa lta bu/ bar nas byon pa rnams dge 'dun mang po chos 'khor la 'du ba lta bu/ 'og nas byon pa rnams sa chen po'i rlangs pa 'phyur ba bzhin du 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub/ me tog gi char 'babs bzhin pa dang bcas 'byon par bsam la/ dzaḥzhes rdo rje khu tshur gyi g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung la g.yas pa'i mdzub mos steng nas 'khyud pa'i lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bya/ g.yas pa steng du byas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgyab sprad pa bzhag pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas hūm̐ zhes brjod pa ye shes pa rnams rang la sib kyis thim/ rdo rje khu tshur bsdam pa gyen du bkan pa'i mdzub mo gnyis dang mthe'u chung phan tshun so sor 'khyud pa lcags sgrog kyi phyag rgya dang bcas bam̐ zhes brjod pas chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin ro gcig tu gyur/ rdo rje khu tshur bsdam pas g.yon pa'i steng du g.yas pas bzhag pa dril bu'i phyag rgya dang bcas hoḥzhes brjod pas byang chub snying po'i bar du 'bral ba med par dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsam mo// de nas pad skor dang bcas 'khyud rgya byas la yo ga shuddha'i sngags brjod pa'i sgo nas tha mal gyi 'du shes spangs te lha'i nga rgyal brtan po bzung*/ 'di nas mdor bsdus nas/ sems 'dzin la nyin snga ma'i snyan shog rgyas pa zhes pa'i mtshams nas phrag pa gnyis kong mo sogs med pa'i thal gong rgyas pa/ phyag gnyis padma rā ga'i lcugs phran ltar byin gyis phra zhing mdzes pas g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ nu 'bur shin tu rgyas pa mthong ba tsam gyis bde ba chen po bskyed nus pa rnams so sor sems 'dzin/ 'phros mdor bsdus dang yang bskyar skabs phye/

bcu gnyis pa rdzogs/ ༈ /bcu gsum par/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lus dkyil gyi zhal shes ni/ rdo rje dril bu pas/ bcos ma gnyis kyi ngo bo gang*// de ni gdul bya'i dbang las 'dod// mkhas pa'i sgrub bya de min te// yang dag don mthong grol phyir ro// zhes pa dang*/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ rdo rje'i lus la yul chen sum cu so bdun gyi rtsa khams yi ge tshang bar gnas/ de'i nus pa snying dbus la gnas pa'i rtsa khams la tshang bas rnal 'byor ma'i snying po oṃ gsum ma yig 'bru so gnyis/ bam̐ yig gi srog gi a thung 'byung bzhi'i yi ge dang bcas pa byung*/ de rnams 'dir lhar bskyed pa'i lus dkyil 'di ni rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la snyan brgyud 'ba' zhig tu bzhugs pa brgyud pa zam ma chad pa las byung ba kho na rjes 'brang yin lo ba phal cher gyi rna bar ma thos pa'i chos yin zhes gsungs pa ltar nang rdo rje'i lus kyi gnad la brten nas zab pa'i spyad gzhi khyad par can lhar bskyed pa'i gdams pa ste/ dus phyis kyi slob ma re re la gcig brgyud du mdzad pa'i phyag bzhes yod kyang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub nas bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid rdzogs par 'bebs na slob ma gang yod la zhal shes 'di nyid mnyam du 'chad par mdzad pa yin la/ de lta bu'i lus kyi lha rnams bskyed rdzogs tshul ji lta bu zhe na rgyu rkyen gnyis kyi sgo nas bskyed pa la dang po ni/ dpyid thig las/ rgod ma kha ni me yi gzugs// phag mo ti la ka zhes brjod// ces pa ltar lte bar gnas pa'i khams dmar po la nang gi phag mo'am/ dpyid dang thig le'i ya gyal ti la ka'i sgras bstan pa de nyid snying gar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbus zla dkyil gyi dbus su bam̐ yig gi rnam par gnas pa dang*/ yang de nyid las/ phyogs ni rnam pa bzhir gnas pa'i// 'byung ba chen po'i rtsa bzhi ste// zhes pa ltar snying ga'i 'byung bzhi'i khams bab pa'i rtsa bzhi'i ngo bo bam̐ yig gi rgyur gyur pa'i 'byung bzhi'i sa bon ya ljang gu/

ra dmar po/ la ser po/ wa dkar po bzhi bam̐ las phye ba'i tshul gyis chad de rim pa bzhin bam̐ gyi g.yon dang*/ rgyab dang*/ g.yas dang mdun rnams su bkod/ gzhan yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ nyi shu rtsa bzhir phye ba yin// gnas rnams dag ni thams cad du// rtsa rnams kun ni yang dag bshad// yul 'di rnams kyi bu mo gang*// rtsa yi gzugs kyis gnas so zhes// zhes gsungs pa ltar pu li ra ma la dang*/ dza landha ra sogs phyi'i yul nyer bzhi'i bdag nyid can du gnas pa'i mgo bo dang*/ spyi gtsug sogs kyi rtsa nyer bzhi dang*/ las kyi rlung ngam byed dag gi /khwa gdong gshin rje ma sogs brgyad// ces pa'i khwa bsags sgo brgyad kyi khams rlung dang bcas pa dbyer med pa'i ngo bo oṃ gsum pa'i yi ge mar me'i phreng ba lta bu'i bam̐ gyi mdun nas brtsams te g.yon skor du 'khod par sgom pa ni gang las skyes pa'i rgyu'i khyad par ro// rkyen ni dbang dus su ting lo sbyin ma'i brda thabs sogs kyis ye shes pa phab cing*/ gsang dbang gi skabs su lha'i bdud rtsi lus thams cad kyi rtsa thig rlung bcas byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ skabs 'dir bam̐ yig gi 'od kyis lus kyi nang thams cad gsal bar byas pa las skad cig gis lhar bskyed pa ste dbus kyi bam̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las gtso mo rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo/ ya ra la wa'i yi ge bzhi yongs su gyur pa las shar du mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu khaṇḍa ro hi ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo ste snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi mtha' skor gyi oṃ gsum ma'i yig 'bru so gnyis yongs su gyur pa la rab gtum dang gtum mig ma la sogs pa'i dpa' mo nyer bzhi dang*/ khwa gdong ma dang gshin rje brtan ma sogs sgo mtshams ma brgyad bcas kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma dmar mo so gnyis/ de dag thams cad kyang 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi zhabs mnan las pad nyi'i gdan med pa gzhan rgyan cha lugs rigs bdag dang bcas pa phyi'i rnal 'byor ma ji lta ba che chung gi tshad ni dbus kyi rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam du bskyed na/

'khor rnams de'i phyed tsam du gsal gdab/ de ltar bsdom pas lus kyi rtsa de dang de dag gi nang du las rlung dgu brgya phrag re rgyu ba/ 'dir rtsa thig rlung gsum ngo bo dbyer med lha'i rnam par sems bzung bas las rlung de dag gi rgyu ba rim bzhin 'gag pa'i stobs kyis sa dang po nas bcu gnyis pa'i bar gyi rtogs pa mngon du 'gyur bar byed cing*/ gzhan yang kyai rdo rje las/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang*// zhes gsungs pa ltar phyi nang gi rten 'brel stobs su gyur pa las gnas yul gyi mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du 'du zhing*/ de dag gis sgrub pa po'i rgyud byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ba'i gsang chen lam gyi zab gnad mthar thug pa'o// de nas go cha dgod pa ni/ rang dang lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad kyi lte ba sogs gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re de yang phyi rol du rgyan btags pa lta bu dang*/ nang du sngags 'khor dgod pa'i gzhi lta bu ma yin par/ sku gzugs las zur du dbyer mi phyed pa lta bur chu nang zla gzugs 'char ba bzhin ngos bslang gi rnam pa can skya khyi li li ba re re bsam/ zla gdan de dag gi steng du rim pas lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ kha steng lce la hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral ba ste spyan dbu ma'i steng du hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug ste skra mtshams nas gyen du sor bzhi'i mtshams su hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag ces pa dpung pa dang sog pa 'brel ba'i tshigs mtshams gnyis/ lag pa'i mkhrig ma gnyis/ dpyi gnyis/ long bu gnyis te de dag tshigs mtshams rnams su phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo/ yi ge rnams zla ba'i ngos la rgyab brten pa'i tshul gyis bsgom/ de yang gong gi snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i sku mdog dang 'dir yan lag la ngos 'dzin tshul 'dra min sna tshogs 'byung yang gsang chen slob bshad 'dzin pa'i brgyud pa'i gsung sgros dri ma med pa 'di kho na'o// 'di nas mdor bsdus nas sems 'dzin la nu 'bur shin tu rgyas pa bde ba bskyed nus pa zhes pa'i mtshams nas/

sku sked phra la grim pa/ brla sogs sku smad kyi cha cher rgyas pa chu 'dzin gsal zhing rgyas pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes bskyed nus pa/ 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ 'phros mdor bsdus yang bskyar skabs phye/ bcu gsum pa rdzogs/ ༈ /nyin bcu bzhi par/ nyin snga ma'i sems 'dzin gyi 'phros nas/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan gdan bai ḍūrya'i 'khyud mo nas bzung rgyan yongs rdzogs la sems 'dzin btang*/ ngag gi bzlas pa la sngags bzla ba'i dgos pa/ phreng ba'i khyad par/ de nyid byin gyis brlabs pa/ bzlas pa'i tshul dngos so// dang po gnad dang ldan pas gsang sngags kyi bzlas pa byas pa'i mthus lha'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te byin rlabs kyi 'jug pa bla lhag tu myur ba yin no// gnyis pa ni/ zhi ba la shel/ rgyas pa la gser/ dbang la tsandan dmar po/ drag po la ru rakṣa sogs las so so'i khyad par dang*/ spyir bo dhi tsitta las thams cad la sngags par gsungs shing khyad par rgyud a bhi dha na las/ dung chen phreng ba blang nas ni// de nas de las bzlas pa bya// zhes gsungs pas/ skabs 'dir thod pa'i phreng ba nyid shis pa yin/ de yang sngar gzhan gyis longs ma spyad pa/ phreng thag ras bal sogs bu mo grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pas dgu sgril du byas pa/ mdo 'dzin nyis brtsegs bcas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ grangs ni rgyud sogs nas las kyi dbye ba sna tshogs gsungs kyang 'dir dam pa gong ma'i gsung rgyun ltar brgya dang bcu gcig gi grangs tshang bar byas na gzhi bsnyen 'bum phrag bzhi'i kha bskang bzhi khri bzhi stong bzhi brgya phrag re dgos pa'i bzhi brgya tsam ma gtogs bsnyen pa las zur du ma bsags kyang zhar byung du 'gro ba'i dgos pa yod do// byin gyis brlab pa'i tshul ni/ rang gi lag pa g.yon padma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte bar zla ba'i steng du a dkar po'i mthar ā li dkar po g.yon skor/

lag pa g.yas rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar kā li dmar po g.yon skor du bsam/ phreng ba'i steng du suṃ dkar po/ hūm̐ sngon po/ āḥdamar po/ oṃ dkar po rnams brtsegs mar gnas par bsam la phreng ba snyim par bzhag a mṛ tas bsangs te/ stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phreng thag hūm̐ las gtso bo rdo rje sems dpar nye ba'i sras brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ phreng ba rnams āḥlas dgra bcom pa/ mdo 'dzin oṃ las 'og ma gzugs kyi sku dang*/ steng ma chos kyi sku ste/ de rnams kyang lha'i sku'i rnam pa ma yin par de dang de'i ngo bor mos pa tsam byas la/ oṃ pa de pa de ma hā dzñā ni sarba buddha ma yaṃ bha be ta hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho hoḥ a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes phreng ba gsar pa la brgya rtsa dang rgyun du skabs dang sbyar te bzlas/ rang gi thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad ā li kā li'i rnam par spyan drangs te phreng bar thim par bsam/ mthar lag pa gnyis thabs shes kyi sbyor bas bsrubs pas yi ge rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa phreng bar thim par mos la phreng bar sngags kyi has btab/ 'di nyid rgyun du ma grub na oṃ gsum ma nyid lan gsum bzlas pas kyang rung ngo*// tshul ji ltar bgrang ba ni g.yon pas snying ga'i thad du mthe bong lcags kyu'i tshul gyis dngos grub 'gugs pa'i bsam pas bgrangs shing*/ g.yas mnyam bzhag gis phreng ba brten pa'i rnam pa bya'o/ bzlas pa dngos la/ bkod pa'i bzlas pa/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa/ 'gog pa'i bzlas pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni lus dkyil gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar chos 'byung zla ba sngags 'khor dang bcas pa gsal btab/ yig 'bru rnams la sems gtad nas klog pa'i tshul du sngags bzla/ gnyis pa la don byed kyi dmigs pa gnyis las/ dang po gzhan don don byed kyi dmigs pa ni/

snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i sku'i nang thams cad 'od gsal bar byas/ rim bzhin rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang dpa' mo so gnyis/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba bcas kyi sku thams cad 'od kyi snang bas gsal bar byas/ rang gi lus las kyang phyir thon/ phyogs bcur 'phros/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas de rnams kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas sbyangs te thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa'i zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'ur ldir ld-ir brjod par bsam/ gnyis pa bdag don byed kyi dmigs pa ni 'od zer gyi sne mor phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros te/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin la 'gran bzod pa'i mchod pas mchod cing bsnyen par byas/ de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs te rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas myur bul che chung sogs kyi skyon dang bral ba'i sgo nas gzhan du ma yengs pas rang gis thos tsam du bzla'o// bzlas bya'i sngags kyang jo bo nā ro ta pa'i rgya gzhung las/ oṃ gsum sogs mi 'byung ba ni zab gnad 'byin 'jug gis sbas pa yin la/ dngos gzhi rgyal chen ind+ra bhu tis bkral ba'i phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i gzhung nyid phag mo'i chos tshul thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa yin pas/ de nyid kyi sngags btu ba'i cho ga las ji ltar 'byung ba ltar/ oṃ gsum ma nyid bzla dgos pa yin te/ phag mo gzhan gyi gzhung la ma tshang ba rnams kyang gzhung 'dis kha 'gengs par mdzad par rgyud ldan dam pa'i man ngag yin no// de yang khrid yig 'ga' zhig tu thog mar yid bzlas la gtso bor byas nas/ des skyo na ngag bzlas bya bar bshad kyang*/ las dang po pa'i skabs ngag bzlas nyid gtso che bar gsungs pa bzhin dang po ngag bzlas gang 'grub bya/
