'gog pa'i bzlas pa'i yid bzlas ji ltar bya ba ni/ bsam gtan gyi lus gnad dang ldan pas thog mar sna bug g.yon pa nas rlung thog mtha' gnyis 'jam la bar du shugs che ba sangs kyis bus pa dang mnyam du rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyis gtsos pa'i sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa rkyang ma'i lam nas rlung dang 'grogs phyir thon te dang por 'dom gang tsam/ de nas khang pa sogs kyi phyi rol tsam/ de nas kyang je ring je ring du stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams kyang brgal bar song nas/ mthar dud sprin ltar rang yal du song bar bsam la yun ring tsam bzhag rlung ro rdzogs par thon pa'i rtags snying na kam pa byung ba dang*/ yang dal bus rngub ste g.yas nas phyir bsal la ro ma'i lam nas zhe sdang sbyang ba'i dmigs pa dang*/ de nas gnyis ka nas phyir btang la dbu ma'i lam brgyud smin mtshams nas gti mug sbyang ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas tshad sogs sngar bzhin bya/ bum can lan mang du 'dzin na/ slar yang de 'dra yongs rdzogs lan gnyis byas la/ rlung ro dgu phrugs su bsal/ grangs gnyis gsum tsam las mi 'dzin na rlung ro lan gsum bsal bas chog de nas 'og sgo cung zad 'byed 'dzum dang bcas 'og rlung snyan gsan 'bebs pa'i tshul gyis phyed 'then tsam bya/ steng rlung len pa'i tshul gyis rdzogs par rngub nas mchil ma sgra med du mid pa dang mnyam du lto bar mnan/ de'i tshe snying ga'i lus dkyil gdan chos 'byung dang bcas pa steng rlung dang sbrags te lte bar phab pa'i chos 'byung gi rtse mo gsang bar thug tsam yod par bsam/ de dang mnyam du lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad yig 'bru'i rnam par bsgyur nas/ ya ra la wa bzhi bam̐ yig la thim par bsam/ slar 'og rlung rdzogs par 'then te srog thur bsres nas lus tshag ha cang grim drag pa ma yin par rang babs su glod/ rang sems lte ba'i bam̐ yig la zhugs pa lta bus sngags 'khor g.yon skor du klog pa'i tshul gyis rlung thub tshad bzung*/

mi thub pa 'dra na btsan thabs su mi bzung bar 'og rlung 'then ne ba'i ngang nas sna sgo'i spu mi 'gul ba'i tshod kyis dal bus btang*/ cung zad ngal gsos la yang 'dzin pa sogs gang thub kyi sgo nas yid bzlas bya/ 'di nas 'phros mdor bsdus bskyar chos skabs phye/ bcu bzhi pa rdzogs/ ༈ /bco lnga par/ rgyan gyi sems 'dzin mthar/ phyag g.yas g.yon gyi phyag mtshan gnyis/ kha ṭwāṃ ga rigs bdag rnams la dmigs bsal du sems 'dzin cing*/ res 'ga' rigs bdag nas pad gdan bar/ res de las ldog pa/ res phyi'i 'od phreng nas nang du dang*/ res de las ldog pa'i 'gres kyi sems 'dzin/ spyi dang bye brag gi sems 'dzin de dag thams cad la yang gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad/ mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro bcad de/ bsgom pa ni rnam rtog gi dug dbyung ba yin la/ de yang dper na spyan dbus ma lta bur thog mar yid dmigs rlung gsum hril gyis bsgrim la dmigs pa gtad/ bar du shes pa lhod kyis klod la cung zad mnyam par bzhag de la gnas cha brtan po yun ring bar yong du re bas de dag rgyun du mthud na rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar du gcod cing*/ de 'dra ba yang yang byung na rjes dmigs pa gtad res kyi rnam rtog gi bar du gcod pas langs shor du 'gro/ gal te gsal po ma byung yang gsal la res yun bskyangs na shes pa 'thib po de gar rgya 'byam du 'gro bas myur du rang dbang ba'i tshul gyis 'phro bcad de rang so 'dzin pa ste/ de la ched du mi rtog par ma yengs tsam gyis rang babs su ngal bso/ yang rtse gcig tu bsgrim nas rig pa gsal ba dang*/ sngar bzhin rang babs su glod nas bsgom pa res 'jog tu gom par byas pas gsal cha dang gnas pa thams cad brtan cing yun je ring du 'gro'o// de nas dmigs pa thog mar brtan pa cung zad thob pa'i rtags la/ snang phyogs kyi ngo bo nyid/ stong phyogs kyi ngo bo nyid/

zung 'jug gi ngo bo nyid gsum du yod pa'i/ dang po ni spyan dbus ma lta bur sems bzung bas ji ltar bsgom pa'i spyan de 'dra ba rang gi dpral bar mig gis mthong rgyu'am lag pas reg rgyu yod dam snyam pa lta bu'i nyams dang*/ yang na dpral ba na lhang lhang pa/ za ba/ sbrid pa sogs 'byung ba'am/ gnyis pa ni/ bsgom pa'i spyan gsal mi gsal yang mthar kun rtog rags pa thams cad ched du bkag pa ma yin par rang 'gags su song nas rang dbang med pa lta bu snang ba stong cham me bar gnas pa 'byung ba ste/ de nyid stong nyid rtog pa'i lta bar mi 'gro yang de la brten nas rim bzhin bsgom pas rnam par mi rtog pa'i stong nyid myur du rtogs par 'gyur ba yin no// sems 'dzin skyong tshul spyi bshad 'di rgyas bsdus ci rigs nyin bzhin mdzad kyang 'jug pa bde phyir bsdom nas dkod pa'o// gsum pa ni dmigs pa 'dzin pa'i tshe glo bur du du ba lta bu dang*/ smig rgyu lta bu dang*/ me khyer lta bu dang*/ nam mkha' nas re kha nag po thur du brkyangs pa lta bu dang*/ sgra gcan gyi lus shin tu 'jigs pa'i phyed sogs 'od gsal gyi rtags rnams rim bzhin 'char ba'o// bzlas dmigs yang bskyar skabs phye nas/ zhar byung rdzogs rim gnyis kyi dang po la dngos dang*/ yan lag gnyis las/ dang po rlung bum pa can sngar bzhin bzung la/ lte ba'i chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa g.yon skor du shugs drag tu 'khor bas bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skyes par bsam/ de yang chos 'byung gi grwa zur gsum pas shes rab ma'i padma dang*/ steng gi dga' 'khyil bzhi'i kunda lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems las byung ba'i dga' ba bzhi/ de re re la yang 'khyil chung bzhi re yod pas dga' ba'i dga' ba sogs dga' bzhi'i ye shes bcu drug mtshon par byed pa'o// gnyis pa yan lag ni/

bde ba skye bar 'dod na rang lhar gsal ba'i bha ga padma kha bye ba lta bu'i nang du dga' 'khyil dmar po drod kyi rang bzhin can g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor ba la dmigs pa gtad/ bde ba ha cang ches nas 'dzags pa sogs kyi gegs sel la dga' 'khyil de nyid lte ba'i bam̐ yig la thim par bsam/ mi rtog pa skye bar 'dod na smin mtshams su dga' 'khyil dkar po shel dkar gyi khu bas bris pa lta bu g.yon skor du sngar bzhin 'khor ba la dmigs pa gtad/ rtog pa rags pa 'gags nas sems byings por song na dga' 'khyil bam̐ yig la bstim ste rig pa'i gsal cha bskyed/ 'di nas 'phros mdor bsdus yang bskyar skabs phye/ sdud rim gyis sbyang gzhi ma dag pa 'khor ba'i snod bcud 'jig pa sbyangs shing*/ sangs rgyas rnams mya ngan las 'da' ba'i mdzad pa de dang chos mtshungs la/ de las thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang bas snod bcud chag pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams zhi ba'i dbyings su mi bzhugs par sems can gyi don la sprul pa'i rnam pa rgyun mi chad par ston pa dang chos mtshungs pa yin no// 'phros mdor bsdus yang bskyar skabs phye/ bco lnga pa rdzogs/ ༈ /bcu drug par/ lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i spyan dbus ma'i sems 'dzin btang*/ de nas bzlas dmigs sogs bskyar chos thog zhar byung rdzogs rim gnyis pa ni/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i sku snang stong gnyis su med pa dar dmar gyi gur phub pa lta bu'i dmar seng nge ba rang gi lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa/ mar sna gsang gnas dang yar sna spyi gtsug nas mar gug ste smin mtshams su zug pa gsal btab/ lus gnad dang ldan pas rlung 'dzin pa dang sbrag pa'am ma bzung kyang rung ste/ dbu ma'i mas sna gsang ba nas dga' 'khyil dmar po mtshal zhun gyi khu bas bris pa lta bu chung ngu zhig dbu ma'i nang nas yar g.yon skor du dmar chi li li snying ga'i bar byung bas rtog pa rags pa rnams 'gags te snang ba thams cad stong pa'i rang bzhin du cham cham song*/

yang yas sna smin mtshams nas dga' 'khyil dkar po zhig g.yon skor du skya chi li li rtsa nang nas spyi gtsug gi bar yar song*/ de nas mar bya babs pa ltar babs pas snang ba thams cad bde ba'i rang bzhin du cham cham song*/ gnyis ka snying ga'i thad du reg la ma 'byar ba'i tshul gyis g.yon skor du shugs drag tu 'khor/ mthar gnyis ka gcig tu 'khrug gis 'dres te dga' 'khyil dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa gcig tu gyur/ de yang je phrar song ba'i mthar dbu ma'i nang gi stong pa'i dbyings su mi dmigs par bsams la bde stong gi ngang la mnyam par bzhag des ni 'chi dus su khams dkar dmar yas mas nas gnas 'phyug par brten snang mched gnyis dang*/ khams gnyis snying gar 'dus pa'i bar du rnam shes tshud par brten nyer thob kyi snang ba 'char ba rnams sbyongs shing*/ mthar stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa goms pa'i stobs kyis nyer thob kyi rjes thog de ma thag tu gzhi dus kyi 'od gsal 'char ba'i tshe ma pang du bu rgyug pa lta bu'i 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pas rab 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi skur 'tshang rgya ba'am/ 'bring 'od gsal ngo 'phrod pa sogs kyi smin byed khyad par can du 'gyur bas 'da' ka ma'i gnad kyi gdams pa yang mthar thug pa yin no// de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa'i nyams len gyi gtso bo bskyed pa'i rim pa yan lag dang bcas par dbang bzhi'i lam gyi nyams len mtha' dag gi gnad ma tshang ba med pa 'dus pa yin te/ lus rtsa'i dkyil 'khor dag pa rang phyi'i rnal 'byor ma'i skur bsgom pa dang snying ga'i sngags phreng rnams dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma'i skur bskyed pa tsam du ma zad kha ṭwāṃ gar he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor thams cad tshang ba dang*/ snying ga'i chos 'byung gnyis kyi yab he ru ka'i gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa/ zla dkyil gyi lha tshogs rnams mtshon pa bcas mdor na yab yum gnyis ka'i bskyed rim gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa nyams su blang bar 'gro bas bum dbang gi lam/

rtsa yi ge'i dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa ji ltar mtshon pa'i tshul yang yod de/ snying ga'i chos 'byung gi 'og mas gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo e yig gru gsum gyi rnam par yod pa mtshon/ chos 'byung steng mas lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab lte ba'i rtsa mdud zur gsum du yod pa mtshon/ zla dkyil gyis snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo zlum por yod pa mtshon/ bam̐ yig gi srog ya ra la wa'i yi ge bzhis mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug gi rtsa ba'i rtsa bzhi mtshon/ zla ba'i steng gi sngags 'khor yig 'bru so gnyis kyis spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis dang bam̐ yig gi nā das dbu ma mtshon pas gsang dbang gi lam gyis gang la gnad du bsnun nas bsgom bya'i gnad thams cad tshang zhing de la dmigs te bsgom pa'i yon tan rnams kyang mtshon byed sngags 'khor zla ba chos 'byung dang bcas pa bsgoms pa las 'byung bas gsang dbang gi lam/ chos 'byung gi grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin can du bsgom pas padma can sogs las kyi phyag rgyas bskyed pa'i lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po mtshon pa sher dbang gi lam/ dbu ma'i yas mas kyi dga' 'khyil 'du 'phrod kyi mthar stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ der ma zad skyabs su 'gro ba nas bzung rang bzhin med pa'i lta ba bskyangs pa thams cad gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po ste dbang bzhi pa'i lam gyi ngo bo yin no// 'phros mdor bsdus yang bskyar skabs phye/ gnyis pa mnyam par ma bzhag par thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor las nyal ldang bdud rtsi myong ba gsum song zin/ gtso bo snang grags rig pa'i khyer so ni/ gzugs su snang ba thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur/ sgrar grags pa thams cad oṃ gsum ma'i gdangs/ yid kyi dran rtog thams cad bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rnam rol tu lta ba dang mi 'bral bar bya'o// bcu drug pa rdzogs/

༈ /bcu bdun par/ lus dkyil gtso mo'i sku yongs rdzogs rgyan dang bcas pa'i sems 'dzin btang*/ 'phros mdor bsdus yang bskyar skabs phye nas kha zas kyi rnal 'byor la rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i tshul gsum las/ dang po ni bza' btung thams cad sumbhas bsangs sbyang sngon du 'gro bas phyag rgya dang bcas oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥgasum gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/ snying gar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la skyabs yul thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ lte bar gtum mo'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i khrod du 'jig rten pa'i mgron rnams gsal btab la/ lag pa dgang gzar dang blugs gzar gyi rnam pas g.yon pa'i kun spyod kyis longs spyod pas snying ga dang lte ba'i lha tshogs thams cad mchod pas tshim/ snyigs ma rnams gtum mo'i mes bsreg par bsam/ 'bring snying ga'i bam̐ yig lha'i ngo bor gnas pa la thim pas dgyes te gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par bsam/ tha ma kha zas thams cad kyang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bor mos la/ lha la lha thim pa'i tshul gyis longs spyod/ zhar byung gos sogs kyang lha rdzas kyi na bza' dwangs shing thogs pa med par bsams la rang lha'i 'du shes kyis longs spyad nas mtshon gnas yo byad thams cad la tha mal gyi 'du shes spangs la longs spyad pas kha zas dang yo byad rnams bu lon can du mi 'gyur zhing bsod nams kyi tshogs bde blag tu rdzogs par 'gyur ro// phyi rol mchod pa ni/ rab mdun bskyed sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad bshams la sgrub mchod dang sbrel bar mchod gtor dang tshogs kyi 'khor los mnyes par bya/ 'bring sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor tsam mam ma grub na me long la chang gis chos 'byung tsam bris par brten kyang rung ba yin no// sbyin sreg gi cho ga ni be'u bum du yig rnying ci rigs bzhugs kyang gsang chen slob bshad kyi gdams pa 'dzin pa kun gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag bzhes rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa'i cho ga ltar bsnyen pa sogs kyis kha bskang ngam/

min kyang dus skabs gang yang rung bar byas pas bar chad zhi zhing tshogs bsags kyi thabs bla na med pa yin la/ sbyin sreg dngos ma grub kyang sdig pa sbyong byed mar me'i sbyin sreg sogs la brtson par bya'o// bcu bdun pa rdzogs/ ༈ /bco brgyad par/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i spyan dbus ma nas bzung rgyan can rgyan med yongs rdzogs kyi sems 'dzin btang*/ 'phros mdor bsdus yang bskyar skabs phye/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa ni/ tshogs bsags pa gtso bor byed na yar ngo'i tshes bcu dang*/ sdig sgrib sbyongs shing nyams chag bskang ba gtso bor byed na mar ngo'i tshes bcu ste rab dus gnyis ka'am/ tha ma gang yang rung ba gcig la nges can du bya dgos shing*/ de yang rgyas pa na sku tshom bu/ gsung bdud rtsi/ thugs sindhu ra ste dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sam/ tsandan dmar pos byug pa'i maṇḍal tshom bu bkod pa tsam la yang brten pas rung tsam ste bdag mdun bsgrubs zhing dbang blangs la tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa rgyas par 'bul/ de tsam ma grub na 'bring grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa'i bu mo lha grangs dang mnyam par dpral bar sindhu ra'i thig le bya zhing ku sha'i gdan bkram pa sogs kyi cho ga tshul bzhin bya ba'i sgo nas bza' btung gi ston mos tshim par bya ba rigs la mchod pa dang*/ de yang ma grub na tha ma dam bca' las gsum 'gyur gyi sngags bzlas pa tsam gyis kyang go chod pa yin no// gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ ku bag ste sha chang gi dam rdzas nges par tshang zhing bsgrub pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu dang sbyar ba'i gtor ma dbyibs padma'i snying po ltar zlum pa/ 'phral gtor la pad 'dab dang 'dzin gtor sogs la mtheb kyus bskor la gtsang sbra dang ldan pas bshams/ sumbhas bsangs sbyangs sngon du 'gro bas lag pa g.yon bstan la oṃ brjod pas dngos 'dzin dang tha mal gyi snang zhen thams cad stong par sbyangs/

g.yas bstan la āḥbarjod pas thod pa'i snod stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam par bsam/ gnyis ka bstan la hūm̐ brjod pas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rdzas kyis phyur bur gang bar bsam/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bcas la/ ha ho hrīḥbarjod pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po bsam/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya ni gdan bzhi las/ lag pa gnyis ni bkan byas la// srin lag gnyis ni phan tshun dkris// gung mo dang ni mtheb rtse sbyar// khro bo gnyis kyis mnan par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de yang gtor ma sngar byin rlabs ma byas pa'i gsar pa yin na sngags brgya rtsa re dang gzhan bdun nam gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i phyag rgya dang bcas phaiṃ gyi sgras gtor mgron rnams cho ga las 'byung ba bzhin spyan drangs/ de rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gu bdud rtsir zug pas gsol bar bsams la/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje thal mo kha phyes nas se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ gtor sngags lan grangs ci rigs par phul/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod cing nang mchod 'bul/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra dang bcas rgyas par na rkang pa brgyad pa'am/ bsdu na dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs shlau ka gnyis kyis bstod/ chos 'di'i srung ma dur khrod bdag po yab yum la gtor ma 'bul ba phyag bzhes su yod cing*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag gi gtor ma sogs kyang btang*/ mgron rnams rten la brtan par bzhugs pa'am rang la bsdu ba dang gshegs su gsol ba skabs thob dang bstun par bya'o// de ltar thun dngos dang thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor la dus rtag tu brtson pa dang*/ khyad par du gzhi'i bsnyen pa 'bum phrag so gnyis mthar phyin par byas pas rab rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal bud med kyi rnam par byon nas sgrub pa po'i lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste lus ma spangs par tshe 'dir dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su khrid par gdon mi za'o// de la mkha' spyod kyi gnas chen po ni sangs rgyas kyi sa dngos yin la/

'bring ni mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas rig pa 'dzin pa'i grong khyer khyad par can te/ der phyin ma thag phung po rag pa 'di nyid 'chi med kyi 'ja' lus su gnas 'gyur zhing*/ longs spyod thams cad kyang nam mkha' las 'bad med du 'byung la/ tshe bskal par thub pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro nas chos nyan cing dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis grogs dang phyag rgya'i nye rgyu thun mong ma yin pa mdzad pa la brten nas tshe der bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa 'bras dus kyi mkha' spyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa yin no// bco brgyad pa rdzogs/ ༈ /bcu dgu par/ mtha' skor rdo rje rnal 'byor ma so gnyis rgyan can rgyan med yongs rdzogs kyi sems 'dzin dang*/ zhar byung rdzogs rim gyi yang bskyar thog bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor la thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa/ dang po ni/ snying ga'i sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis khams gsum snod bcud thams cad la khyab pas gzugs med khams 'od sngon po'i rnam par zhu nas rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i sku'i stod kyi cha la thim/ gzugs khams 'od dmar por zhu nas bar gyi cha la thim/ 'dod khams 'od dkar por zhu nas smad kyi cha la thim/ rang lha skur gsal ba yang 'od dmar por zhu nas snying ga'i chos 'byung dang*/ de zla ba/ de sngags phreng*/ de bam̐ yig de zla tshes/ de thig le/ de nā da/ de yang je phrar thim pa'i mthar/ rang sems stong pa ha chad ma yin pa'i gsal zhing rig pa de'i ngo bo gang du ma grub pa'i stong pa gnyis zung du 'jug pa de ga'i ngang la dmigs gtad gyi mtshan 'dzin ma zhugs par bzo med rang babs su ci gnas su bzhag pa'i mthar skad cig gis thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang*/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi sdud rim ni/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma sba lcag 'bring po tsam chu shing sdong po ltar drang pa/

padma'i 'dab ma ltar srab pa/ til mar gyi mar me ltar gsal ba/ rgya skyegs kyi khu ba ltar dmar ba ste khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa/ yas sne tshangs bug gi thad du zug pa/ de yang 'pho ba sogs kyi skabs ltar tshang bug kha bye ba ma yin pa/ mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad du slebs pa/ g.yas su ro ma khrag gis gang ba'i rnam pas dmar zhing tsha reg dang bcas pa/ g.yon du rkyang ma khu bas gang ba'i rnam pas dkar zhing gsher bag dang bcas pa/ ro rkyang gnyis ka'i yar sne sna bug g.yas g.yon la zug cing*/ mar sne lte ba'i mtshams nas dbu ma la zug rtsa gsum gyen du gshibs cung zad reg la ma 'byar ba/ mas sna lte ba nas sbubs stong gcig tu 'dus pa'i dbu ma'i mar snar rang sems rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor tsam pa/ de yang dge slong ring mo ba'i zin bris sogs su phyag gnyis thur du brkyang zhing sku drang por bzhengs par mdzad kyang khrid rgyun 'dir bdag bskyed bsgom don dang mthun pa'i sku rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa gdan dang bcas pa'am gdan med kyang rung bas gang bde gsal ma thebs kyi bar du yang yang bsgom/ rlung phyir 'gro ba dang bstun/ rang sems rnal 'byor mar gsal ba de'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od dmar po tsha zhing 'khyug pa glog gi zer ma lta bu zhig chad/ dbu gtsug nas thon/ ro ma'i lam brgyud de sna g.yas kyi sgor slebs pa dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pas gzung rtog thams cad dag cing ro ma'i rtsa lam sbyong*/ sku de las 'od zer dang rang 'dra'i sku nyi ma bye ba'i gzi 'od can khams gsum thams cad skad cig gis khyab par 'phros/ snod thams cad 'od kyi rnam pa can dang*/ bcud thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur lam gyis gnas 'gyur te mthar de thams cad kyang 'od dmar po'i phung por zhu nas sna sgo'i rnal 'byor ma'i skur thim/ de yang 'od dmar po'i rnam par zhu nas dmar 'khyug ge sna bug g.yon pa nas rlung rngub pa dang 'grogs te rkyang ma'i lam brgyud lte ba'i rnal 'byor mar thim pas 'dzin rtog thams cad dag cing rtsa lam sbyangs par bsam la rlung gnas pa dang bstun nas cung zad mnyam par bzhag

de ni rtsa lam sbyangs pa yin pas nyer gcig bdun lnga gsum sogs grangs ci rigs par sbyang*/ de nas rang sems rnal 'byor ma de nyid mkha' spyod du gshegs par ring ba'i tshul gyis gar stabs ling ling bzhugs par bsams la rang phyi'i rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gdan zhabs gnyis la thim/ zhabs sku'i rdza mar thim/ de nas rang gi sems rnal 'byor ma de nyid lte ba'i rtsa gsum phrad mtshams su yar byon pas ro rkyang gnyis cha yig gi rnam par zhabs mthil gnyis kyi 'og tu yar zug dbu ma dbu gtsug nas mar zug par bsam/ rnal 'byor ma de nyid snying ga'i bar du rgyang gis byon pas phyi'i sku smad kyi cha thams cad kyang nang gi lha skur thim/ ro rkyang gnyis yar thim zhing*/ dbu ma mar thim pa'i tshul gyis je thung du gyur/ de bzhin du mgrin par byon pas phyi'i sku'i bar gyi cha dang rtsa gsum yang sngar bzhin thim/ spyi gtsug tu byon pas phyi'i sku dang rtsa'i lhag ma thams cad sngar bzhin rdzogs par thim nas rang sems lha skur gsal ba de nyid rtsal po ches mda' 'phang ba bzhin du nam mkha'i dbyings su blos mi 'khyud pa'i tshad du gshegs pa'i mthar nam mkha' la sprin yal ba ltar gyur par bsams la rang sems thabs bde ba chen po dga' chen he ru ka'i ngo bo dang*/ stong cha rdo rje btsun mo'i ngo bor gnas pa kha sbyor zung du 'jug pa'i lta thog tu mnyam par bzhag pa ni/ smon lam du/ nang gi phag mos gzung 'dzin 'khri shing bcom zhes sogs shlau ka gcig gi don no// de'i ngang nas nam mkha'i dbyings de gar chu las chu bur rdol ba ltar rnal 'byor ma'i skur ldang nas mar babs te rang gi go sar slebs tsam gyis sngar bzhin phyi'i rnal 'byor ma rtsa gsum dang bcas pa lam gyis grub par bsams la/ de lta bu'i rnal 'byor grangs ci mang du nyams su blang bar bya ba ni/ bskyed rim la brten nas mkha' spyod bsgrubs pa'i zab gnad kyi snying po yin no// 'phros bskyar chos thog dbang po 'bring sindhu ra'i sgrub pa la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i tshul ni gzhi'i bsnyen pa bzhi lnga tsam legs par thim nas sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sindhu ra'i tshom bu bkod la oṃ gsum ma'i bzhi 'bum gyi bzlas pas bsgrub cing*/

de yang rab sindhu ra thun re la gsar pa re brje ba'am ma 'byor na nyin re la nges par gsar pa re brje/ rnying pa rnams chud ma zos par nyar tshag byas nas sgrub pa'i sngags grangs thim nas/ yar ngo'i tshes bcu gcig dang bstun sindhu ra rnams shing laṅka li ya'am/ ma rnyed na bod du skyes pa'i do rgod pa ste sman do bar grags pa'i rkang gi sbubs stong gad dar byas pa'i nang du blugs/ gshags shing gis bcad pa'i mdun du dga' ba 'khyil pa'i sar brko zhing kha legs par bcad pa rang gis khyer te de nub sa rub nas grogs 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsnyen song zhig gi rnal 'byor gyi dbyug pa rang gi lag pa gnyis snying gar rtse sprad gru mo phan tshun brgyangs pa'i tshad dang mnyam pa khyer la dur khrod du phyin nas rang sdod pa'i sar dong brus pa'i nang du sindhu ra'i snod bzhag kha mi mngon par byibs/ dong de'i khar bsdad la srod 'khor tsam gyi bar lha'i rnal 'byor dang ma bral bar bzlas pa la 'bad/ de'i rigs grogs des kyang sumbha ni'i sngags bzla zhing phyi nang gi bar chad bsrung*/ de nas nang du log nyin par sngar bzhin bsgrub mchod la brtson zhing mtshan mo dur khrod du phyin nas gong bzhin du byas nas nyi shu gsum gyi dgong mo nam gyi sum cha gcig gi bar dang*/ bzhi la sum cha gnyis/ lnga la mtshan thog thag dur khrod du sgrub pa byas pas grub pa'i rtags sa 'og tu sbas pa'i rdzas las sgra 'byin pa 'od 'phro ba sogs 'byung zhing*/ ma byung kyang de nas bzung rang rnal 'byor kun tu spyod pa'i chas su/ sindhu ras dpral bar dga' 'khyil gyi par btab la snod mchan khung g.yon du mi mngon par bcangs nas nges pa med pa'i yul grong spyi dang khyad par 'phang ra lta bu bud med 'du gang che sar phyin te nyul bas ji zhig na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal bud med kyi tshul bzung ba dang mjal bar 'gyur zhing*/

de yang rnal 'byor ma yin pa'i rtags su de'i dpral bar rang gi smin mtshams kyi dga' ba 'khyil ba'i ri mo 'phos yong bas de la the tshom med par g.yon nas bskor zhing phyag 'tshal ba sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas rab de nyid du sgrub pa po'i mkhrig ma nas phyag gis bzung ste mkha' spyod kyi zhing du khrid pa'am/ gzhan du na gnas skabs su chos ston pa sogs kyi sgo nas dngos grub ci rigs pa stsal zhing mthar nam zhig bar do'i snang ba shar ba'i de ma thag tu rjes su 'dzin par mdzad do// bcu dgu pa rdzogs/ ༈ /nyi shu par rgya che ba la sems 'dzin pa ni/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba de nyid je cher song nas mthar stong khams thams cad gang ba tsam du song bar bsam zhing*/ lus dkyil gyi lha rnams kyang je cher song bar bsam la phyi nang gi lha re re nas rgyan can rgyan med yongs su rdzogs par sems bzung*/ gnyis pa rdzogs rim thun mong chos nyid dngos su ston pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa chos nyid brgyud nas ston pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dper na mi zhig gi rgya mtsho chen po'i gnas tshul rnams rtogs par 'dod nas de'i tshul ji lta bu zhes dris par/ rgya mtsho de ni gting zab la rgya che ba/ ngom gnag pa/ chu srin mang po nye bar gnas pa/ ba tshwa'i ro dang ldan pas btung du mi rung ba zhig go /zhes brjod mi de'i rgyud la tshig tsam la brten pa'i rgya mtsho'i mtshan nyid 'ol tsam 'char ba bzhin du/ 'dir yang maṇḍal gyi byin rlabs brda thabs sogs kyi sgo nas ston pa ni gang zag dbang po mchog 'ga' zhig la sngon gyi bag chags nye bar sad nas de tsam gyis don rtogs pa 'byung srid kyang gzhan la ni ma yin no// des ni de'i byin rlabs kyi sgo 'phyed tsam du yab dang thun mong ba'i rdzogs rim gyi skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni rgya mtsho'i tshul gyi shes par 'dod pa'i gang zag des rgya mtsho ga la ba der bgrod pa'i lam gyi tshul rnams legs par bstan nas/

des lam der zhugs nas phyin pas mthar rgya mtsho chen po ji lta ba mngon sum du rtog par 'gyur ba bzhin no// de yang dpe gsum gyis don gcig mtshon pa ni/ bshan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa/ shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa/ sgyu ma mkhan 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad la mkhas pa'i dpes rnal 'byor pa lam gyi gnad la mkhas pa mtshon pa yin cing*/ de yang rgyud sde'i 'og ma gsum sogs su ma bshad pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad ni rdo rje lus kyi rtsa'i gnad rnams yin la/ de dag las kyang mchog tu gyur pa dbu ma'i gnad la mkhas par bsnun pas lhan skyes kyi ye shes bde blag tu 'char ba'o// de la dang po rlung dbu mar sdud pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ 'dus nas ji ltar bsgom pa'o// dang po ni lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pa'i lus gnad bcas la/ rang gi lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma yar sna spyi bor zug pa'i sne mo haṃ yig dkar po thur bstan rkang pa spyi gtsug tu zug pa lta bu'i mgo bo rtsa nang du chud pa'i tshul gyis bkag pa/ mar sna khrid yig la gsang gnas su zug par gsungs kyang 'dir bla ma'i gsung rgyun la lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad du slebs pa/ ro rkyang gnyis dang bcas pa gong du bshad pa bzhin gsal gdab rlung ro dgu phrugs su bus/ 'og rlung phyed 'then gyi thog steng rlung rdzogs par mnan/ slar 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gsum byas nas 'og rlung rdzogs par drangs la kha sbyar du bzung*/ lte ba'i rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i sne mo sbubs stong gcig tu gyur pa'i nang du tsaṇḍa lī'am gtum mo ram̐ yig gi rnam pa can che chung ril ma tsam pa me'i rang bzhin can/ rtse mo nas me lce dwangs la gsal ba tsha reg bzod par dka' ba cung zad 'bar bar sems gtad la thun rer bum can brgya phrag gam nyer gcig tha ma yang bcu gcig tsam 'dzin/ bum can re re yang thun stod du me dmigs dang mthar lta thog tu cung zad re bzhag pa ni mu stegs byed sogs kyi gtum mo las khyad par du 'byed pa'i tshul yin la de ni dang po me gso ba'i dmigs pa yin pas nan tan bya/

thog ma nas me cher 'bar bar sems bzung nas dmigs pa 'byams te yon tan skye bul ba yin no// bsam mi khyab sogs 'phros bskyar/ nyi shu pa rdzogs/ ༈ /nyer gcig par/ phra ba la sems 'dzin pa ni rang lha skur gsal ba je chung du gyur nas mtheb sor tsam pa dang lus dkyil rnams kyang spu shad kyis bris pa tsam la sems bzung*/ de nas bar rnams bskyar chos thog shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa'i dpe ni/ rgya gar lho phyogs ḍā ki ta zhes bya bar shing gi rigs gcig la mon pa st+wa gri thogs pa brgya phrag mang pos bcad kyang*/ phyogs gcig nas ji tsam bcad kyang phyogs gzhan nas skye bas gcod mi nus pa zhig yod par/ de la shing mkhan shing gi gnad shes pa gcig gis shing la chu rgyu ba'i gnad che ba gcig tu khab tsam gyis gzer phra mo zhig btab pas ring por mi 'gyang bar bskam nas rang 'gyel du 'gro ba yin/ dpe de bzhin du rnal 'byor pa bsgom pa'i gnad la mkhas par bya dgos/ de yang gzhi chos can 'khor ba'i gnad/ lam bsgom pa'i gnad/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gnad rnams su yod pa las/ dang po ni/ 'khor ba'i gnad gang du skye 'gyur gyi las kyi bag chags rnam shes kyi steng du bsgom pas tshe snga ma nas 'chi 'phos pa'i bar srid kyi rten la lus rten 'tshol ba'i 'dun pas pha ma'i kun sbyor mthong ba'i tshe mngal du 'jug cing*/ der zhugs ma thag stong pa'i 'od gsal mngon du 'char yang bsgom stobs kyis ngo ma 'phrod pas mthar de las ldang bar rtsam pa'i tshe 'od gsal de la 'dzin pa phra mo zhugs par brten/ khu khrag gi gong bu'i de'i dbus rtsa dbu ma chags/ stong pa la 'dzin pa zhugs pas g.yas su ro ma/ gsal ba la 'dzin pa zhugs pas g.yon du rkyang ma rnams chags pa/ de las rim gyis rnam rtog je rag je mang du 'phel bas kun rtog gi rnam pa mtha' yas pa rgyu ba'i rtsa'i grangs ji snyed cig chags te rim bzhin mngal gyi gnas skabs yongs su rdzogs pa'i lus grub par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa lam bsgom pa'i gnad ni sngar bzhin me gso ba'i dmigs pa de nyid rtse gcig tu bsgom pas lte ba dang mchan 'og sogs su drod khol bur skye ba sogs kyi rtags byung na/

me de nyid las cher 'bar bas rtsa gsum gyes mtshams nas ro rkyang gnyis kyi nang du yar dmar dengs kyis 'bar bas lus kyi rtsa khams snyigs ma thams cad bsreg khams dwangs ma thams cad dngul chu ltar zhu ba ro rkyang gnyis nas babs pa rtsa'i sum mdo gang ba me dang 'phrad pas slar yang me cher 'bar dbu ma'i nang du zhugs te snying ga'i 'og sor bzhi'i thad tsam du me lce'i rtse mos slebs pa/ me de yang tsha ba/ dmar ba/ gsal ba/ myur ba'i khyad chos dang ldan pa me de'i tsha rig gis spyi bo'i haṃ yig las khams dkar po'i rgyun 'o rkyal la khab kyis bsnun pa bzhin skya phrom phrom babs/ snying ga'i 'og tu me dang 'phrad pas me de nyid sngar las tsha ba'i reg bya ches cher 'bar/ lus sems la lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po bzod par dka' ba brgyal 'gro ba tsam skyes par bsam la gong bzhin bum pa can brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig bcu gcig sogs ci nus su 'dzin/ nyer gcig pa rdzogs/ ༈ /nyer gnyis par 'gal 'du skyon med la sems 'dzin pa ni/ rang phyi'i rnal 'byor ma'i sku nam mkha'i khams gang ba tsam du je cher song zhing lus dkyil thams cad spus bris pa lta bu'i je chung du song bar bsam la/ phyi nang gnyis kar sems 'dzin/ yang phyi'i sku je chung du gyur te mthar mtheb sor tsam mam/ yungs 'bru tsam du gyur zhing lus dkyil rnams je cher nam mkha' gang ba tsam la sems bzung*/ de yang phyi'i sku chung bas lus dkyil rnams nang du mi chud pa lta bu ma yin pa dper na rgya khab kyi bug pa shin tu phra ba'i nang nas yul khams rgya che ba mthong ba lta bu 'gal med du bslab/ shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa'i dpe'i rjes su sgyu ma mkhan 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad la mkhas pa ni/ yul rgya gar du rgyal po tsa dza de ba zhes bya ba'i pho brang gi sgor shing gi mi ring ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor rgyun mi chad du bskor ba du mas bsrung ba la/

gzhan thabs tshul gang gis kyang 'jug mi nus par/ sgyu ma mkhan 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad shes pa gcig gis skud pa phra mo tsam bcad pa 'khrul 'khor rang zhig tu song bas bde bar 'jug nus/ dpe de bzhin du shes gsung*/ bshad bskyar ma'i thog yang na ro rkyang nas khams dwangs ma'i rgyun babs pas rtsa gnyis gang*/ de nas mi dmigs kyi spros pa dor te 'og rlung shugs drag tu gyen du drangs pas ro rkyang nas babs pa'i khams thams cad dbu ma'i nang du yar lud nas mer gyis khengs pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyes par bsam/ 'di khrid yig chen mo'i dgongs pa yin pas thun 'jug tu skabs su bya zhing gtso bo gong gi me dmigs la 'bad par bya'o// gnyis pa rlung lus la bcug nas bde ba sgrub pa dang*/ sems la bcug nas stong pa bsgrub pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma yar sna spyi bo nas mar gug pa smin mtshams su kha gtad pa'i sne mor chos 'byung dmar po gdengs ka phyir bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba'i nang du bug pa thal le yod pa dbu ma'i rtsa sne'i nang du chud pa/ dbu ma'i mar sna gsang gnas kyi rtsa ba nas padma'i nang du gug pa/ padmar chos 'byung dmar po gdengs ka phyir bstan pa'i bug pa dang rtsa'i sna sprad pa/ de nas smin mtshams kyi chos 'byung nang du thig le dkar po sngo mdangs cung zad chags pa/ 'od kha dog lnga ldan 'phro ba 'dar phri li li g.yo ba skad cig kyang ltar mi bzod pa lta bu gcig gsal btab la dmigs pa gcig tu gtad pas gnas der bde ba skye zhing za ba sogs kyi rtags ma byung bar bsgom/ de nyid chos 'byung nang du yar zhugs dbu ma'i gug mtshams kyi nang spyi bo'i thad du slebs pa dang*/ yang der sngar bzhin sems bzung*/ de nas thig le de las khams shel dkar gyi skud pa lta bu skya nar gyis babs pa'i sne mor thig le mu tig gi rdog po lta bur yod pa gcig mgrin pa'i thad du slebs par bsams la der thig le g.yo zhing 'tsher bar sems bzung*/

de nas rim bzhin snying ga lte ba/ gsang ba'i chos 'byung gi nang mtshams su rim bzhin babs par bsams la gnas so sor sems bzung la yas babs kyi dga' bzhi bskyed/ de nas chos 'byung gi nang nas kyang phyir sor do tsam dang sor bzhi tsam du nar gyis 'phyang bar bsams la sems bzung*/ bde ba che drag pas 'dzag pa sogs kyi nyen byung na nyams dang bstun la rim bzhin nang du sdud/ yang chos 'byung gi nang dang lte ba na rim bzhin spyi bo'i thig le la thim pa'i bar du gnas so sor sems bzung la mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi bskyed/ 'phros bskyar chos dkyus su 'jug ༈ /nyer gsum par/ phyi rol yul snang thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur shar ba la dmigs te sku mdog phyag mtshan sogs rim bzhin gsal btab la sems bzung*/ de nas 'phros rnams bskyar chos kyi sgyu ma mkhan 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad la mkhas pa'i dpe'i mthar/ bshan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa ni/ srog chags che ba'i rigs gsod pa la yan lag sogs la mtshon ji tsam bsnun kyang 'phral du mi 'chi la/ bshan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pas srog rtsa lta bur mtshon phra mo tsam btab pas de ma thag srog 'dor bar byed/ 'phros bskyar chos thog gnyis pa rlung sems la bcug nas stong pa sgrub pa ni/ dbu ma dang yas mas kyi chos 'byung rnams sngar bzhin gsal gdab par khrid yig chen mo sogs las gsungs pa ltar ram/ bla ma'i gsung sgros bzhin chos 'byung mi bsgom par dbu ma'i yas mas kyi sne gnyis smin mtshams dang gsang ba'i khar thad bcad kyi rnam par yod pa gang rung gsal btab la thog mar smin mtshams su chos 'byung nang ngam dbu ma'i sner sngar ltar thig le kha dog lnga ldan phra chem chem pa 'dar phri li ba zhig gsal btab/ de nas spyi gtsug tu spo ba dang*/ de las yas babs dang mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi bskyed pa bcas gong bzhin bsgom/ de nas spyi bo'i thig le de las 'od dang thig le 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pa can dpag med 'phros/

rang lhar gsal ba'i dbu nas rim bzhin sku gzugs thams cad 'ja' tshon kha dog lnga ldan gyi rnam par bsgyur/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pa snod bcud thams cad bde ba chen po'i rnam rol 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i rang bzhin bun long long ba khra shig shig pa'i rnam par gyur/ de dag kyang mthar nam mkha' la yal ba bzhin bde stong gi ngang du mi dmigs par bsam pa'am/ yang na de thams cad tshur 'dus/ rang lus 'ja' tshon du gyur pa dang bcas pa thams cad spyi bo'i thad kyi gzhi'i thig le la thim/ de nyid kyang mi dmigs par bsam pa gang rung gi sgo nas stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag tshul snga ma ltar la/ de ltar rang lha skur rtsa thig le dang bcas lam gyis gsal 'debs shing*/ phyi ma ltar na stong pa'i ngang las rang gi smin mtshams kyi thad du thig le de khra chem gyis grub/ de nas rang gi lus rtsa dang bcas pa grub par bsam/ de gnyis gang byas kyang yang smin mtshams su thig ler sems bzung ba/ spyi bor spo ba yas mas kyi dga' bzhi bskyed pa rang gzhan thams cad 'ja' 'od du bsgyur ba/ stong sbyang rim pa gnyis gang rung gis mi dmigs par bzhag pa sogs sngar bzhin grangs ci mang du bsgom/ de lta bu'i rlung lus la bcug pa 'di dmigs pas lus kyi khams snyigs ma thams cad zad nas khams dwangs ma 'ba' zhig gis lus thams cad rgyas par 'gyur zhing*/ rlung sems la bcug pa'i dmigs pas lus kyi khams kyi dwangs ma rnams stong gzugs 'ja' lus kyi ngo bor bsgyur ba byed pa yin no// de las goms pa cher gyur pa na kun 'dar gsang spyod kyi goms pa de nyid brtan mi brtan gyi tshad legs par bzung*/ gang la yang mi 'jigs pa'i gdengs rnyed pa na phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod pa spyad pas padma can sogs mtshan ldan gyi phyag rgya'i nye rgyu la brten nas mchog gi dngos grub myur du mngon du byed par 'gyur ro// 'phros bskyar/

nyer gsum pa rdzogs/ ༈ /nyer bzhi par bsam mi khyab kyi bsdu rim gyi ngang nas thun mtshams kyi lha skur langs/ de nas dngos gzhi sher dbang gi lam mtshon pa'i rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor dang nang gi mkha' spyod bsgrub pa bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i sdud rim gnyis po gang rung gi lam re res kyang 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku'i go 'phang thob par byed pa yin na yang lam gyi chad mthud lta bu'i 'da' ka ma'i nyams len 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor nyams su bstar ba la/ yab yum zhal sbyor la brten pa'i 'pho ba dang*/ yum rkyang la brten pa'i 'pho ba gnyis/ dang po ni rang thun mtshams kyi lhar gsal ba'i sku'i dbus su/ rtsa dbu ma rag dung mgo mjug ldog pa lta bu yar sna spyi gtsug tshangs bug tu zug cing*/ mar sna lte bar 'khyil ba'i thad du slebs pa'i mtshams nyi ma'i gdan dmar chi le ba gcig gis snyug tshig ltar bkag pa/ de'i steng rtsa nang du rang sems rnal 'byor ma'i sku mtheb sor tsam pa gcig gsal btab/ rang gi spyi bo'i thad kyi nam mkhar seng khri pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma he ru ka'i rnam pa can sku mdog ind+ra nī la ltar sngo ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ yab la phyag rgya drug dang yum la phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'i mtha' skor kun tu skyabs yul thams cad sprin phung ltar gtibs pa'i yab yum gnyis kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgom pa lta bu'i ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par bsams la/ oṃ shrī tsakra sambha ra sa pā ri wā ra'am/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra'i mthar/ mchod sngags btags pa'i nyer spyod nang mchod dang bcas pas mchod/ chos dbyings rnam dag ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/

sogs ci rigs pas bstod/ de nas tshe 'di'i gnyen 'dun longs spyod sogs 'khor ba'i phun tshogs gang la yang zhen chags kyi 'khri ba thams cad rbad chod du btang la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// lam mchog 'pho bar 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// 'phyugs med mkha' spyod bgrod par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol 'debs grangs ci rigs yid 'khul nges su brjod/ de nas rang sems rnal 'byor ma de nyid bla ma yab yum gyi thugs kar 'pho ba la rings pas 'phar la khad pa 'phur la khad par bsam la ngag tu ī/ zhes brjod pas rnal 'byor ma de rang gi spyi bo'i bar du rgyang gis byon/ hika ces drag tu brjod pas bla ma yab yum gyi thugs kar skar mda' 'phang ba bzhin du 'phos pas bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres par bde stong gi ngang du cham gyis bzhag mthar kā hī zhes brjod pas bla ma'i thugs ka nas rang sems rnal 'byor ma'i sku zur du bye/ tshangs bug nas zhugs te sngar bzhin nyi gdan la 'khod par bsam/ de lta bu'i tshul brgya'am nyer gcig sogs ci nus su nyams su blangs/ dmigs pas dub na bar bar du gdangs snyan po dang bcas pa'i sgo nas gong bzhin gsol gdab kha shas bya ba spel ma'i tshul du bya/ thun mthar spyi bo'i yi dam yab yum rang gi tshangs bug nas byon te snying gar bzhugs pa/ lte ba'i rang sems rnal 'byor ma dang yas mas spyan 'gros kyis gzigs pas gnyis ka'i thugs rgyud bde ba chen pos mnyes te 'od kyi rnam par zhu la khad du gyur pa'i sku las 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa'i sku lus thams cad mer gyis gang*/ tshangs bug 'od kyi rdo rje rgya gram gyis bkag pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam/

lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma snying ga'i he ru ka'i yab yum la bstim pa'am/ lte bar zhugs pa gang bde bya'o// 'phros mdor bsdus bskyar/ nyer bzhi pa rdzogs/ ༈ /nyer lnga par/ yab yum zhal sbyor gyi 'pho ba'i yang bskyar gyi sngon du 'pho ba byed pa'i dus skabs kyang gya tshoms su 'phos na lus kyi lha bshig pa'i nyes pa 'byung bar gsungs pas thog mar 'chi ltas brtag pa gal che bas de yang rgyas par gzhung gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar yin la/ nye ba'i 'chi ltas mdor bsdus nyin grangs du ma'i bar sna bug g.yas nas rlung btud mar rgyu ba dang*/ mig gi yas lcib mnan pas 'od khyil khyil ba mi 'byung ba dang*/ rna ba mnan pas sgra mi 'byung ba dang*/ lag pa'i mthe bong smin mtshams su gtad la nyi 'od du mkhrig mar bltas pas chad pa sogs yin la/ de yang 'chi ltas byung ma thag 'pho bar mi bya bar 'chi ba bslu ba'i cho ga sna tshogs nyams su blangs shing*/ des kyang bzlog pa'i rtags ma byung na rang la chags zhen bskyed pa'i nor rdzas longs spyod thams cad dngos su gtang ba'am/ 'di dang 'di gtang snyam pa'i yid kyis bsngo zin par byas la zhen chags rdul tsam yang med par bya/ de nas 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par bya ste zhes khrid snga ma bskyar/ gnyis pa yum rkyang la brten pa'i 'pho ba ni gzhan phal cher sngar yab yum zhal sbyor gyi skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ba la khyad par ni/ dbu ma'i mar sne chos 'byung gru gsum gcig gi nang du dper na kong bu'i nang du sdong bu gtsug pa lta bur zug pa'i dbu ma'i mas snar rang sems thig le dmar po'i rnam par gsal 'debs pa'am yang na dbu ma'i mas sna zla dkyil gyis bkag par bsam pa gang byas kyang rung la/ bla ma'i gsung sgros la phyi ma nyid gtso che bar mdzad/ de ltar na zla ba'i steng du rang sems 'od dmar po'i thig le 'phur la khad pa zhig tu bsam/ spyi bo'i nam mkhar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro skyabs yul thams cad kyis bskor ba me tog gi char babs shing 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub pa sogs mkha' spyod kyi zhing khams dngos lta bur mos/

ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ oṃ badzra yo gi nī zhes mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro bas phyi nang gi mchod cing bstod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo mkha' spyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs so// sogs sngar bzhin gsol ba btab cing ī hi ka'i sngags kyi 'pho ba dang kā hi'i 'bebs pa sogs sngar bzhin nyams su blangs/ dus rgyun du hika sogs kyi sngags ma brjod par rnam shes yar 'pho ba'i tshe 'og rlung gyen du drangs/ rnam shes spyi bo nas yar 'phos pa dang mnyam du sked pa yan gyi lus rgyab tu gyed tsam bya ste rlung rngub pa dang bstun/ rnam shes mar phab la lte bar gnas tshe rlung kha sbyar 'dzin pa'am ma thub na rang babs su bzhag de lta bu'i tshul gyis nyams su blangs na rlung dang bstun pa de thog mar 'byongs dka' yang 'byongs phyin brtan pa yin la sngags dang bstun pa'am 'pho ba 'byongs sla yang brtan dka' ba yin no// 'di dag ni 'pho ba sbyang ba'i dbang du byas kyi 'chi kha las la sbyar ba'i tshe gsol gdab skabs lam mchog 'pho ba thob par byin gyis rlobs zhes bsgyur zhing*/ hika gi sgra dang bcas bla ma'i thugs kar 'phos nas phaṭaḥphaṭaḥces bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i yi dam dag pa mkha' spyod kyi zhing du gshegs par bsam/ 'phros mdor bsdus bskyar/ 'pho ba 'di gnyis dang po sbyong tshul/ de nas 'chi ltas brtags pa/ mthar las la sbyor tshul bshad na bde ba yod/ nyer lnga pa rdzogs/ ༈ /nyer drug pa sngon 'gro nas thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor bcas gsung bshad mdor bsdus te shar gyis btang*/ de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu la gnas skabs/ mthar thug gnyis las dang po ni/ phrin las bzhi dang*/ grub pa chen po brgyad sogs 'grub par 'gyur zhing*/ mthar thug ni mkha' spyod chen po'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa'o// de lta bu tshe 'dir ma thob kyang 'bring bar do/

tha ma skye ba phyi ma/ yang tha skye ba bcu drug nas nges par 'grub par 'gyur ro// de yang khrid kyi tshe thun bzhi nges can dang*/ rgyun du rab thun bzhi/ 'bring gsum/ tha mas gnyis sam/ ma mtha' thun re chag med bya/ long ma byung ba'i tshe bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ sdud rim gnyis/ thun mong byas pas go chod cing*/ sems 'dzin ni bzlas pa'i tshe byas pas chog rdor sems kyang thugs dam gzhan gyi skabs btang zin na 'dir nges par mi dgos/ de dag ni tshar chos kyi rim pa'o// nyer drug pa rdzogs/ ༈ /nyer bdun par rje btsun yab dang thun mong ba'i rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma che ba'i bka' khrid la snga dro chos nyid dngos su ston pa'i byin rlabs gnang*/ phyi dro rdor sems brgyud 'debs smon lam bcas dkyus ltar dang kun slong bcos shing gdams ngag gi che ba brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas bla ma dang yi dam la phyag 'tshal bar mos la gang drin ma dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyi rjes zlos maṇḍal tshom bdun ma tshar gcig dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag la chos dbyings phyag rgya chen po da lta nyid du rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol gdab lan gsum/ yang me tog bkye bsdu byas la phyag 'tshal maṇḍal gsol gdab bcas sngar bzhin tshar gnyis kyi rjes mar maṇḍal rgyas pa/ de rjes slar yang gsol gdab tshar gcig mdzad/ me tog bkye bsdu yang maṇḍal gyi grangs bzhin lan gsum mdzad/ bla mas phyag rgya bcas phyogs mtshams bsrung*/ dngos gzhi gong du nyams su len pa'i sar rnal 'byor gyi bde ba'i stan la 'khod/ mdun du bsgrub pa'i maṇḍal tshom bu lnga pa gcig dang gzhan yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten bkram zhing 'byor na mchod pa yang bsham/ gong du bskyed rim gyi skyabs 'gro'i skabs bzhin gnas khang gzhal yas khang gi dbus su seng khri'i steng du bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/

de'i mtha' skor du sngar bzhin nam smin mtshams kyi nam mkhar gang bder brgyud pa'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/ khri de'i steng gi shar du bde mchog sogs yi dam gyi lha tshogs thams cad zhal gtso bor phyogs pa'am mdun gzigs gang bde/ g.yas su rigs lnga bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong sogs longs sprul gyi sangs rgyas rnams/ rgyab tu chos dkon mchog gsung rab glegs bam gyi rnam pa gdong dar khra chem me ba/ g.yon du nyan rang sogs thun mong ba dang*/ byang sems sogs thun mong min pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs/ de dag gi mtha' skor dang steng 'og nges med du skyabs yul gzhan thams cad bsams la/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa 'di skabs mchod lha spro ba mi dgos gang drin ma dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas phyag 'tshal zhing bstod/ de nas dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang*/ rim pa gnyis kyi rtogs pa khyad par can dus myur ba nyid du/ da lta nyid du/ 'dug sa 'di nyid du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab mthar skyabs yul rnams mtha' nas rim nang ma nang mar thim/ rjes rtsa ba'i bla ma yang 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsams la lta thog tu bzhag nyer bdun pa rdzogs/ ༈ /nyer brgyad par rdor sems bsgom bzlas gong bzhin gyi mthar rdor sems rang la bstim pa'i lta thog nas rang rnal 'byor ma'i skur lam gyis gsal ba'i gnas rnams su go cha bkod/ phyogs mtshams srung 'khor bsgom la bzlas pa cung zad byas/ nyer brgyad pa rdzogs/ ༈

/nyer dgu par sngon 'gro rlung sbyong ba/ bdag byin gyis brlabs pa/ dbu ma kha 'byed pa'i man ngag dang gsum/ dang po ni/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa gsum sbubs stong gcig tu gyur pa'i mgrin pa nas gsum du dgyes pa'i dbus ma smin mtshams dang gzhan gnyis po sna bug tu zug pa/ mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad du slebs pa zla dkyil gyis bkag pa'i steng du dbus su nam mkha'i rlung gi rang bzhin gyi ti la ka ste thig le sngon po/ shar du rlung gi thig le ljang gu/ lhor sa'i rlung gi thig le ser po/ nub tu me'i rlung gi thig le dmar po/ byang du chu'i rlung gi thig le dkar po/ de rnams kyang rtsa sba lcag tsam du bsgom na thig le sran ma tsam dang rtsa mda' smyug tsam du bsgom na thig le yungs kar tsam bsgom/ thams cad gsal dwangs 'tsher ba'i rnam pa can du legs par gsal btab/ de nas thun chen gcig la nang gsal gyi thun chung re 'byung ba'i dang po la thog mar rlung sna bug g.yon nas rgyu ba dang 'grigs na dngos grub myur zhing gzhan yang g.yas dang dbus sogs gang na rgyu brtags la de dang bstun pa'i dbus kyi thig le sngon po de la nam mkha'i rlung spos rengs kyi dud pa ltar sngo na ra ra gyen du byung*/ rlung g.yon g.yas gang nas rgyu ba'i sna bug dang mnyam du rgyu na dbu ma nas thon phyi sor bcu gnyis tsam du sngo khyil song*/ nang du rgyu ba dang bstun nang du zhugs dbus kyi thig ler thim/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis 'byung 'jug gnas pa gsum grangs gcig tu brtsis pa nyer gcig bdun sogs gang rigs kyis rtsa lam sbyang nas rjes ma rlung nang du rngubs pa thig ler thim par bsams la steng rlung mnan 'og rlung ci bder bzhag la/ lag g.yon grangs 'dzin gyi phreng ba mnyam bzhag tu bzung ba g.yas kyis pus mo g.yas g.yon gnyis su reg la yang g.yas kyi steng thad du se gol gcig brdab la rlung btang*/

de lta bu bdun nam bcu gcig tsam bya/ de nas cung zad ngal bso// nyer dgu pa rdzogs/ ༈ /sum cu par sngar bshad pa'i dpe gsum gyis don gcig ston pa rnal 'byor pa lam gyi gnad la mkhas dgos par gsungs pa rgyas par 'chad pa la/ gzhi chos can 'khor ba'i gnad ni las nyon gyi gzhan dbang gis ma'i mngal khu khrag gi thig pa'i dbus su rnam shes zhugs pa'i 'od gsal gyi skabs su snga ma'i lam bsgom stobs kyis ngo shes shing lam du long na de nyid skye ba sprul pa'i skur sangs rgyas pa yin la/ de tha mal du shor na ji zhig ltar na/ de las ldang ma thag dper na sngar ngo cung zad shes kyang ma 'phrad par yun ring song ba'i mi zhig rjes su mthong ma thag 'di ni 'di'o zhes ngos zin la khad pa la snga ma'i nges pa mngon du ma gyur pas ngos 'dzin mi nus pa'i sems klong klong po 'char ba bzhin du snang ba thams cad 'di zhes 'dzin mi nus kyang de la rtog pa yang yang zhugs pa'i rnam rtog phra mo zhig skye zhing*/ de ni brjod med la 'dzin pa zhugs pas de la brten nas khu khrag mer mer po de'i dbus na yar/ rtsa a wa dhū ti'am/ a na ha ste gzhig tu med pa dang kun 'dar ma sogs ming ji snyed du gsung ba'i rtsa dbu ma rta rnga brgyar gshags pa tsam chags/ de nas rtog pa cung zad rag tu song nas snang ba thams cad stong sang nge ba zhig 'dug snyam ste stong pa la 'dzin pa zhugs pas g.yas su ro ma dang*/ snang ba thams cad gsal seng nge ba zhig 'dug snyam ste gsal ba la 'dzin pa zhugs pas g.yon du rkyang ma rnams rim par chags/ de nas rtsa 'khor thams cad las sngon du lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo chags pa yin te lte ba'i thad nas dbu ma las phyogs bzhir rtsa 'dab bzhi chags pa'i dbus su nam mkha'i rlung dang khams kyi dwangs ma'i rang bzhin gri gug gi so lta bu/ shar gyi 'dab mar rlung gi rlung dbyug pa lta bu/ lho'i 'dab mar me rlung tsheg drag lta bu/

nub kyi 'dab mar sa rlung thong gug lta bu/ byang gi 'dab mar chu rlung thig le lta bu/ rtsa 'dab de re re las phyir gnyis re gyes pa'i rtsa 'dab brgyad la mdun nas g.yon skor du a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha ste khams kyi dwangs ma yig 'bru brgyad kyi rnam par gnas pa de re re las 'byung ba lnga'i rlung cha mnyam re re rgyu/ 'di dang dus mnyam du snying ga'i 'khor lo yang chags/ de'i phyir rtsa 'dab bcur gyes pa las mdun nas g.yon skor du rtsa 'dab dang por rtsa ba'i sa rlung stobs che ba gcig dang gnyis pa yan lag gi rlung stobs zhan pa gcig de bzhin du rtsa ba dang yan lag gi 'byung rlung lhag ma rnams rgyu/ de'i phyir rtsa 'dab bcu gnyis su gyes par mdun nas sngar bzhin a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥste dbyangs bcu gnyis las thung ngu dang po lnga dang āḥlas pho rlung*/ ring po lnga dang aṃ las mo rlung rgyu zhing de yang pho rlung thams cad ro ma dang*/ mo rlung thams cad rkyang mar zhugs pas rlung thams cad phan tshun du thag 'thag pa'i snal ris bzhin du rgyu/ de'i phyir rtsa 'dab sum cur gyes pa la mdun nas/ ka kha ga gha nga nas dro ba'i yi ge bzhi spangs pa'i sha ṣa sa ha kṣa'i bar du gnas pa'i sde pa drug gi sde pa dang po ka tsa ṭa ta pa sha rnams las sa rlung*/ kha tsha ṭha tha pha ṣa rnams las chu rlung*/ ga dza ḍa da ba sa rnams las me rlung*/ gha dzha ḍha bha ha rnams las rlung gi rlung*/ nga nya ṇa na ma kṣa rnams las nam mkha'i rlung rnams rgyu/ de yang rnam shes bzhon pa po dang rlung bzhon pa lta bur rtsa nang rnams su rgyu ba'i yul rtsa'i khyad par gyis thog ma lte ba'i rtsa rnam rtog rag pa yod kyang gsal bar mi 'char la/ snying gar rnam shes tshogs drug rgyu ba'i rtsa 'khor sogs su slebs pa'i tshe snga ma las gsal bar 'char zhing*/ mgrin pa'i ming tshig gi brjod pa sna tshogs rgyu ba'i rtsar zhugs pa'i tshe 'di dang 'di'o zhes tha snyad so sor 'char ba yin no// de ltar gzhi chos can 'khor ba'i gnad 'di nyid thog mar nges par bya ba ni dper na sman pa mkhas pas dang por nad ngos 'dzin pa lta bu/

nyin snga ma'i yang bskyar thog rdor sems skabs gzhan du song zin na 'dir 'jug pa bde ba'i khyad kyis ma byas kyang 'gal ba med pas de ltar na tshogs zhing rnams la gsol ba btab ste dbang bzhi blangs nas/ tsham rngam sngags kyi sgo nas bsrung ba bya/ de nas skyabs yul bsdus bstim gyi dmigs pa'i mthar lha skur langs/ yang bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can rigs bdag tu bzhugs par gong bzhin gsol gdab tshar gcig dang srung 'khor gyi rnam pa rnams yid la dran tsam bya/ de nas shar gyi rlung gi thig le ljang gu la dmigs nas rtsa lam sbyong ba sngon du 'gro bas steng rlung mnan/ sngar bzhin bum can pus mor reg tsam se gol brdab pa can lan gnyis kyi bar bzung la gtad/ ngal gso zhing gsol gdab srung 'khor gsal 'debs tsam bya ba bcas sngar bzhin la/ lho'i sa rlung la dmigs pas lam sbyangs shing bum can sngar ltar tshar gsum gyi bar dang*/ nub kyi me rlung la bzhi/ byang gi chu rlung la lnga/ de gnyis kyi bar du yang gsol sogs sngar dang 'dra ba ste de yan gyis thun chen gcig go /de yang nyin mtshan re la de lta bu'i thun chen drug de re re la 'byung rlung nang gsal gyi dbye bas thun chung lnga re yod pa'i thun chen dang po'i nam mkha'i rlung la dmigs pa'i thun chung la bum can gcig la se gol bcas pa'i lag stab gcig gi yun/ rlung gi rlung lnga thun chung gnyis/ sa rlung la gsum/ me rlung la bzhi/ chu rlung la lnga/ thun chen gnyis pa'i thun chung dang por sngar gyi tha ma'i steng du gcig bsnan pa'i dbang du byas nas drug gnyis pa la bdun/ gsum pa la brgyad/ bzhi pa la dgu/ lnga pa la bcu/ thun chen gsum par yang de steng du gcig bsnan nas thun chung dang por bcu gcig nas bzung sngar gyi rigs 'gres/ thun chung lnga par bco lnga'i yun/ thun chen bzhi pa'i thun chung dang por bcu drug nas lnga par nyi shu/

thun chen lnga pa'i dang por nyer gcig nas lnga par nyer lnga/ thun chen drug po'i dang por nyer drug nas lnga par sum cu ste nyin mtshan gcig gi dbang du byas thun chen drug rdzogs/ ༈ /nyin gnyis pa'i thun chen dang po'i thun chung dang por so gcig sogs sngar gyi rigs 'gre sbyar ba thun chen drug gi thun tha mar drug cu'i yun du 'phel bas mtshon par byas te/ nyin zhag lnga'i skabs su brgya dang lnga bcu dang*/ rim pas nyin zhag bco lnga'i bar du nyams su blangs pas nyin zhag bco lnga'i thun chung tha mar bum can gcig la bzhi brgya lnga bcu'i yun thub pa dbang po rab dang 'bring gi nyin dang po'i thun dang por rlung lnga po re re la se gol sogs re re'i yun/ thun gnyis pa'i rlung lnga re re la gnyis re'i yun sogs thun chen rer grangs re bsnun te nyin zhag bco lngar nyams su blangs pas bco lnga'i thun tha mar dgu bcu'i yun thub pa/ dbang po 'bring dang tha ma ni nyin zhag dang po'i thun chung thams cad la re re'i tshad/ nyin zhag gnyis par thun chung thams cad la gnyis re'i tshad de nyin zhag rer grangs re re bsnan pas bco lnga'i thun tha mar grangs bco lnga'i yun du thub pa ni dbang po'i tha ma ste/ de dag ni sngon 'gro rtsa lam sbyong ba'i dmigs pa'o// gnyis pa bdag byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa ni/ rang gi lus kyi dbus lte ba'i 'og nas rtsa gsum so sor gyes shing*/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi thad du gsum ka sbubs stong gcig tu gyur/ yang de nas rtsa gsum so sor gyes pa'i spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo'i thad du yang rtsa spubs gcig tu gyur zhing*/ de nas dbu ma'i sne mi mngon par ro rkyang gi sna gnyis sba ltar gug pa sna bug gnyis la zug pa rkang mthil gnyis su yam̐ mam̐ dzhaiṃ gang rung bsgom par bshad cing bla ma'i gsung rgyun la phyi ma ltar mdzad pas dzhaiṃ dmar po me'i rang bzhin can dmar hu re ba re re bsgom/

sum mdor rlung dkyil ljang nag gzhu dbyibs g.yo zhing 'tshubs pa/ spyi bo'i thad du kha sbubs gcig tu gyur pa'i nang du haṃ dkar po mgo thur bstan/ de'i steng du ltag pa'i rlung dkyil gzhu dbyibs ljang nag sran ma bkas pa lta bu rnams legs par bsam/ de nas rkang sor dang sgyid pa brkyang bskum drag tu byas pas/ rkang mthil gnyis kyi yi ge las me 'bar rkang pa dang brla'i rtsa bo che brgyud sum mdo'i rlung dkyil la phog pas rlung g.yos/ de las me rlung 'dres pa cher 'bar/ dbu ma'i mar sne'i a la phog de yang me 'bar dbu ma phra bas 'jug ma nus par ro rkyang gnyis nas gyen du rtsa phra la gzhi sbom pa gzugs mo byi dur gyi dbyibs ltar 'bar bar bsam la 'og rlung dal bus 'then/ de nas steng rlung rgyud gcig la rngub chung drag po gsum byas te mnan pas spyi bo'i ltag pa'i rlung dkyil las thur du rlung g.yos pas ro rkyang gi me'i rtse mo thur du brdas par bsams la lte 'og tu kha sbyar ci thub 'dzin/ sum cu pa rdzogs/ ༈ /so gcig par de ltar nyams len la brtson pas lte ba dang mchan 'og sogs su drod tsha tshil le ba skye zhing rim gyis rlung lus la chud pa'i mthus/ lus la gtum mo ye shes kyi me drod cher rgyas pa la brten nas bde chen gyi lus por skye zhing*/ lus shing bal ltar yang ba yod du mi tshor ba 'byung*/ de la yun bsrings te goms pas mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes lta bu'i nyams skye zhing*/ de nas du ba/ smig rgyu/ me 'khyer/ mar me/ 'od phung*/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ sgra gcan te lus stod yod la smad med pa'am zla ba nag po 'jigs su rung ba'i rnam pa/ de nas re khā nag po ste nam mkha' nas zhags pa nag po thur du brkyangs pa lta bu'i 'od gsal gyi rtags rnams 'char bar 'gyur ba ni smon lam las/ lus sems rtsa la dri zhon zhugs pa yis// bde ba mchog gis bdag rgyud tshim par shog

/ces gsungs pa ltar ro// gsum pa rtsa dbu ma kha dbye ba'i rnal 'byor dngos ni/ rtsa sogs gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba la khyad par ni lte ba'i rtsa sbubs gcig tu gyur pa'i thad rtsa 'dab brgyad la a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha de las rtsa 'dab lnga bcu nga drug tu gyes par kā li so bzhi ā ī sogs dbyangs ring po drug a ā sogs dbyangs ring thung bsdom pa bcu drug rnams ngo bo khams rnams kyi dwangs ma la rnam pa yi ge'i gzugs su bsgom/ dbu ma'i mar sne'i aṃ gi thig le'i nang du tha mal gyi gtum mo'i ngo bo kṣuṃ dmar po mgo gyen bstan/ spyi bo'i haṃ yig gi thig ler 'od kyi gtum mo'i ngo bo kṣum̐ dmar mo mgo thur bstan cig bsam rkang mthil gyi yi ge las me sbar ba nas steng rlung gis me thur du brdas par bsam pa'i bar sngar bzhin gyi ngang nas bum can bzung bas me lce rtsa 'khor thams cad du khyab par 'bar/ rtsa khams snyigs ma thams cad bsreg cing dwangs ma thams cad rgyas par byas/ de nas aṃ yig steng 'og gi rlung gnyis kyi cher sbar bas tha mal gyi gtum mo kṣum̐ dmar po las me lce tsha la myur ba 'bar dbu ma nas thogs med du zhugs/ snying gar slebs pa dang de'i tsha zer gyis bskul te spyi bo'i 'od kyi gtum mo las me lce thur du 'bar/ snying gar me gnyis dmar khrug gi 'dres pa dmigs la bum can kha sbyar ci thub 'dzin/ thun mthar bum pa can gsum tsam la 'od kyi gtum mo sbar ba'i tshab tu spyi bo'i haṃ zhu nas byang sems kyi rgyun babs snying ga'i thad du tha mal gyi gtum mo'i me dang 'phrad pas sor sgra dang bcas 'dres pa'i 'bar 'dzag gi dmigs pa bsgom/ me dmigs kyi bum can thams cad kyi stod du rang gi dmigs pa gang yin pa dang mthar 'dzin med du 'jog pa'i bde stong zung 'jug 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes la nye rgyu'i grogs dang bcas te goms pa mthar dbyung bar bya'o/

'di ni smon lam las/ tha mal 'od kyi gtum mo mdzes ldan ma// dhū tir 'dzum dkar bzhad pa'i rol rtsed kyis// haṃ yig gzhon nu yongs su mnyes byas pas// zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i sa thob shog /ces pa'i dgongs pa mthar thug pa'o// so gcig pa rdzogs/ ༈ /so gnyis par rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa lam des bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu ni/ de ltar bsgom pas tha mal dang 'od kyi gtum mos khams kyi snyigs ma thams cad bsreg dwangs ma thams cad rgyas par byas pas ji zhig na lus thams cad khams dwangs ma 'ba' zhig gis gang bas lcags la gser 'gyur gyi rtsis reg pas gser du bsgyur ba ltar tha mal gyi lus shin tu ma dag pa'i khams 'di nyid zag med 'ja' lus su bsgyur zhing*/ rlung sems dbu mar chud pa la brten nas lus kyi rtsa gzhan thams cad ro rkyang gnyis la thim pa'i ro ma e dang rkyang ma wam̐ gyi rnam pas dbu mthar thim/ rtsa 'khor gzhan thams cad lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor thim pa ni lus rtsa'i 'gros thim pa'o// lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyis shar gyi rtsa khams dbyug pa'i rnam pa can de nyid wam̐ gyi rkang pa/ dbus kyi gri gug gi so lta bu'i lto ba/ nub kyi thod gug lta bu'i mgo lho'i tshegs drag lta bu'i gnyis kyi zla tshes zung 'brel/ byang gi nya mig lta bu'i thig le ste mdor na rtsa 'dab bzhi'i rtsa 'khor thams cad bam̐ yig gi rnam par thim phyi'i gsal byed kyi sde pa drug tu 'gyur zhing*/ de drug gi e yig gi g.yon gyi rkang pa gnyis g.yas kyi lag pa gnyis mgo gnyis te drug tu 'dus par gyur nas o yig gi rnam par thim/ dbyangs ring thung sdom pa dang ring po drug po rnams e bam̐ spyi'i rgyur thim pa ste de rnams ni rtsa yi ge'i 'gros thim pa'o// de dang dus mnyam du nang gi rtsa 'dab bzhir rgyu ba'i rlung gi 'gros kyang thim pa ste/ nub kyi sa rlung gi rgyu ba rag pa thams cad 'gags nas byang gi chu rlung la thim/

de lho'i me rlung*/ de shar gyi rlung gi rlung*/ de dbus kyi nam mkha'i rlung la thim pa ni snying po rlung gi 'gros thim pa'o// mthar e wam̐ gnyis dbu mar thim pas sgrib pa gnyis shin tu phra ba'i bag chags dang bcas pa spangs nas rang lus 'pho med stong gzugs 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku dang*/ rang sems rnam par mi rtog bzhin ji lta ji snyed kyi chos thams cad sgrib pa med par mngon sum cig car du gzigs pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes chos kyi sku ngo bo gcig tu 'jug pa'i mkha' spyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur 'tshang rgya ba ni mthar thug gi 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i tshul lo// gnas skabs su yang pū li ra ma sogs phyi'i gnas yul rnams kyi brdar btags pa'i nang gi rtsa de dag la las rlung gi rgyu ba 'gags pas mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'char zhing*/ nang gi rtsa rlung rang dbang du gyur pa'i rten 'brel gyis phyi rol gnas yul de dang der phyogs las rnam par rgyal pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa sogs kyi ched du rgyu bar dbang la/ der bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams padma'i mtsho la ngang pa'i tshogs ltar 'du zhing byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ bde ba chen po'i myur lam las kyi phyag rgya'i grogs mdzad pa sogs la brten nas mchog gi dngos grub bde blag tu 'grub par 'gyur ba ni bla na med pa'i rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i man ngag gi gnad mthar thug pa yin no// e ma ma dag zag bcas phung po lcags kyi khams// 'pho ba med pa'i 'ja' lus gser bzang por// skad cig bsgyur mkhas rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i lam// bskal brgyar bsgrubs pa'i legs byas mthu yis rnyed// bklag lung bshad yam tsam min nyams myong du// bkar ba'i khrid tshul 'khyug pa med pa'i gzer// yang yang snying la btab pa'i gdangs tshad kyis// mkha' spyod 'dzum zhal lta la mi ring nye// yid 'ong sa 'dzin mthon por rang byung gi
